name: Alien Hornet
description: 1.3.0.1 The Alien Hornet is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events, summoned from opened portals in groups of two. If not killed fast enough, it will fairly quickly grow into an Alien Queen. They also grow from the Alien Larva that spawned from the death of an Alien Queen.

name: Alien Larva
description: 1.3.0.1 The Alien Larva is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. They move fairly slowly along the ground, and will only naturally spawn in groups of two or three upon the death of an Alien Queen. If unattended, they will grow into Alien Hornets, which in turn become Alien Queens later on.

name: Alien Queen
description: 1.3.0.1 The Alien Queen is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. It attacks by shooting Alien Goop projectiles that have a / 100% chance to inflict the Distorted debuff for 6–12 / 5–9 seconds. The Distorted debuff causes the player to continually rise and fall in a short wave-like motion. The player's manual vertical movement is mostly disabled, with the exceptions of Hooks and teleporting with the Rod of Discord. Upon death, the Alien Queen spawns two to three Alien Larvae. If not killed, they quickly grow into Alien Hornets which then grow into more Alien Queens.

name: Ancient Doom
description: 1.3.0.1 The Ancient Doom is a Hardmode projectile NPC and boss servant that is summoned by the Lunatic Cultist's attacks in Expert Mode and Master Mode. The attack will only be used when the boss is lower than 50% of its maximum health. The Ancient Doom remains stationary and only deals damage upon contact at first. However, if it is not destroyed, after , it will burst into four "Prophecy's End" projectiles in the cardinal directions. These projectiles cannot be destroyed by weapons, and they deal a very significant amount of damage, especially in Master Mode.

name: Ancient Light
description: 1.3.0.1 The Ancient Light is a projectile NPC fired by the Lunatic Cultist once its health is lowered below 50% of its maximum health. It is fired in spreads of five and can be destroyed with some hits from any weapon. Although the NPC itself has a round sprite, it appears as a star in-game due to visual effects.

name: Ancient Vision
description: 1.3.0.1 The Ancient Vision is a Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by the Lunatic Cultist. It is only summoned if a player attacks a duplicate of the Lunatic Cultist while a Phantasm Dragon is still alive. The Ancient Vision attacks by repeatedly charging at the player horizontally, back and forth, similar to Mothron's charge attacks. The Ancient Vision leaves behind afterimages as it flies.

name: Angry Bones
description: The Angry Bones is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Dungeon. They follow the Fighter AI and can open closed doors after one or two hits. They will sometimes leap towards the player when they get close, or if the player is above them.

name: Angry Dandelion
description: 1.4.0.1 The Angry Dandelion is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on grass during the Windy Day event at daytime. It is stationary and shoots 1–3 damaging Dandelion Seed projectiles at the player every .

name: Angry Nimbus
description: The Angry Nimbus is a Hardmode enemy that spawns when the weather is rainy in any surface biome except for the Snow biome. It will follow players around the map and attempt to release damaging raindrops on top of them similar to that of the Crimson Rod and the Nimbus Rod. It floats directly above the player, making it difficult to hit with close-range weapons.

name: Angry Trapper
description: The Angry Trapper is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle and Underground Jungle biomes and is a much stronger version of the Man Eater and Snatcher.

name: Angry Tumbler
description: 1.3.3 The Angry Tumbler is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert during a Sandstorm. It attacks by rolling towards the player, moving at very high speeds when rolling with in the direction of the Mighty Wind.

name: Anomura Fungus
description: The Anomura Fungus is an enemy found in aboveground Glowing Mushroom biomes at any point in the game, including pre-Hardmode. During Hardmode, they can also spawn in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes.

name: Antlion
description: The Antlion is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in Deserts during the day and in Underground Deserts at any time. It remains stationary with its head sticking out of the ground, turns its head towards the player when they are within its line of sight, and fires Sand Ball projectiles at them once every 3.33 seconds. It can only launch projectiles at an upward angle (within about 45° to the left and right), so players that are approaching from lower ground are usually out of its line of fire. Sand Balls turn into Sand Blocks upon hitting an object, and will gather on the ground, similarly to the projectiles fired by the Sandgun.

name: Antlion Charger
description: 1.3.0.1 The Antlion Charger is an enemy similar in appearance to the Antlion, and is found in the Underground Desert or on surface Deserts during pre-Hardmode Sandstorms. Unlike the Antlion, the Antlion Charger will, as its name suggests, charge at the player instead of remaining stationary. It can jump over blocks and will gradually build up speed while moving before charging the player. It can rarely drop the Mandible Blade.

name: Antlion Larva
description: 1.4.0.1 The Antlion Larva is a pre-Hardmode enemy that is only spawned when Antlion Eggs are destroyed. Its speed, jump height, occurrence in numbers, and small size make it a significant threat in the early game. Multiple Antlion Larvae can spawn from a single egg, which breaks when hit with any weapon or tool. Unlike the Alien Larva, Antlion Larvae will not grow into an Antlion, Antlion Charger, or Antlion Swarmer.

name: Antlion Swarmer
description: 1.3.0.1 The Antlion Swarmer is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy found in the Underground Desert or on surface Deserts during Sandstorms. It is a large dragonfly-like creature that looks similar to the Antlion and Antlion Charger.

name: Armored Skeleton
description: The Armored Skeleton is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It has a chance to inflict the Broken Armor debuff for 2 / 4 / 5 minutes on contact.

name: Armored Viking
description: The Armored Viking is a Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome. It is similar to the Undead Viking, but has greatly increased defense, damage and health.

name: Baby Slime
description: the enemy The Baby Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in groups of 1–3 from a defeated Mother Slime.

name: Basilisk
description: 1.3.0.1 The Basilisk is a Hardmode enemy found in the Underground Desert biome. The Basilisk attacks by charging quickly towards the player while being highly resistant to knockback. It drops 1 to 3 Sturdy Fossils and has a rare chance to drop the Ancient Horn, which summons a mount version of the Basilisk.

name: Bee
description: For other uses of bee, see Bee (disambiguation). The Bee is a small pre-Hardmode flying enemy that usually appears in the Underground Jungle. They can be spawned by the Queen Bee, and will also appear when destroying Bee Hives and occasionally when mining Hive blocks (which are mainly found in Bee Hive biomes). They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree. They attack by flying into their target, dealing contact damage. In Expert Mode, Bees will inflict players with the Poisoned debuff for 2–6 / 2.5–7.5 seconds. On the , Bees can also damage other enemies. Bees can select any enemy (except themselves and the Queen Bee) or the player as their target, and they always attack the nearest target. Bees deal 100% of their contact damage to the target but will also take 100% of contact damage from said target.

name: Black Recluse
description: The Black Recluse is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in and around Spider Nests in the Cavern layer. It has a chance to inflict the Acid Venom debuff for 4 / 8 / 10 seconds. In Expert Mode, it gains a special spit attack that inflicts the Webbed debuff for 0.5–2.5 seconds.

name: Black Slime
description: The Black Slime is a variety of slime that only spawns in the Cavern layer. When a Black Slime attacks, it has a chance to inflict the Darkness debuff, which decreases the radius that light sources will illuminate, making it more difficult to see.

name: Blazing Wheel
description: The Blazing Wheel is an invincible NPC found in the Dungeon that resembles a ring of fire. It travels along the surface of blocks at a very fast speed. Blazing Wheels spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by tiled walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Blood Crawler
description: The Blood Crawler is a pre-Hardmode enemy commonly found in The Crimson. In addition to walking, it can crawl on background walls.

name: Blood Eel
description: 1.4.0.1 The Blood Eel is a flying Hardmode enemy that can be spawned by fishing in water during a Blood Moon. When the bobber dips and the player attempts to reel in a fish, a Blood Eel or another enemy has a chance to spawn within a few tiles of the bobber in place of a fish. Its behavior is rather similar to that of the Wyvern with being able to freely fly, though it moves considerably faster. The Blood Eel requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Blood Squid
description: 1.4.0.1 The Blood Squid is a flying Hardmode enemy summoned by the Dreadnautilus during a Blood Moon. It resembles a regular Squid, but is larger, redder-colored, and has multiple eyes on its body, similar to the Drippler. The Dreadnautilus always summons Blood Squids in groups of three. The Blood Squid attempts to close in on the player before firing a single red Blood Shot projectile at the player, similar to the Dreadnautilus's own Blood Shots, but with higher damage. Like the Dreadnautilus, it recoils after each shot.

name: Blood Zombie
description: 1.3.0.1 The Blood Zombie is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that only spawns during a Blood Moon. It acts mostly the same as normal Zombies, walking towards the player to deal contact damage while attempting to navigate around obstacles, and opening doors if they are in the way. However, it speeds up considerably the closer it gets to the player, and it generally has greater health, damage, and speed than most other Zombies. In Expert Mode, it moves even faster. It does not have any variants, nor does it have an Armed variation in Expert Mode.

name: Blue Armored Bones
description: The Blue Armored Bones is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Similar to Angry Bones, they come in multiple varieties, follow the Fighter AI, and can open closed doors after two or five hits. They also have a chance to inflict the Broken Armor debuff for 10 / 20 / 25 seconds. Blue Armored Bones spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by brick walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Blue Slime
description: The Blue Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that commonly spawns in Forest biomes during the daytime, as well at any time in the Underground layer. Blue Slimes only target the player when damaged, during the night, or at any time when underground.

name: Bone Lee
description: Bone Lee is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It moves at an extraordinary speed, deals large amounts of damage, and has high knockback resistance. It will also spawn at any time in the Dungeon regardless of the type of Dungeon wall present.

name: Bone Serpent
description: The Bone Serpent is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy that spawns in The Underworld. Due to their large size, speed, and high damage, they can be dangerous enemies to encounter, especially if they attack while the player is exploring a Ruined House.

name: Bouncy Slime
description: 1.4.0.1 The Bouncy Slime is a Hardmode slime and boss servant that is summoned by Queen Slime alongside Crystal Slimes and Heavenly Slimes. It shoots Bouncy Gel projectiles at the player every 0.67 / 0.5 seconds.

name: Brain Scrambler
description: 1.3.0.1 The Brain Scrambler is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that appears during the Martian Madness event. It fires green laser projectiles, at a maximum fire rate of once every 0.67 seconds (40 ticks), which have a chance to inflict the Confused debuff.

name: Brain Suckler
description: 1.3.0.1 The Brain Suckler is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events. It latches onto the player's head, dealing large amounts of damage at a steady rate, while also inflicting the Obstructed debuff for the remainder of the time it is on the player. The debuff causes the player's screen to darken significantly, except for a small area around the player, similar to the Blackout debuff. It additionally has the effect of Bleeding, preventing natural health regeneration.

name: Butcher
description: 1.3.0.1 The Butcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It slowly builds up speed over time, similarly to an Antlion Charger, and wields a bloodied chainsaw that deals heavy damage to players on contact. As the Butcher takes damage, its movement speed will increase.

name: Cave Bat
description: The Cave Bat is a common pre-Hardmode bat enemy found only in the Cavern layer. It is fairly small and can be difficult to hit with certain weapons. One is to proceed with caution when entering caves early on, as Cave Bats can pose a moderate threat when one is not prepared to deal with them. In Expert Mode, they can inflict the Feral Bite debuff, making them more dangerous. Like most other bats, they cannot enter water.

name: Chaos Elemental
description: the enemy in the Underground Hallow The Chaos Elemental is a Hardmode enemy that spawns on Pearlstone, Pearlsand and Pink Ice Blocks in the Cavern layer. It runs around and tries to deal contact damage to the player. Occasionally, it will also teleport to a random location on-screen. Like many Underground Hallow enemies, Chaos Elementals have a glowing pink after-image.

name: Chattering Teeth Bomb
description: 1.3.0.1 The Chattering Teeth Bomb is a Hardmode enemy spawned by Clowns during Blood Moons. It hops about, similarly to the Herpling, making small jumps and then large jumps as it makes its way toward the player. Once it is close enough to the player, it will explode.

name: Clinger
description: The Clinger is a Hardmode enemy found in the Underground Corruption biome. Clingers spawn anchored to a block, with their head attached to an extendable "stem" that does not damage the player. They attack by launching orbs of Cursed Flames at the player, which can inflict the Cursed Inferno debuff.

name: Clown
description: The Clown is an uncommon Hardmode enemy that only appears during Blood Moons. Although it has a chance to inflict the Confused debuff upon contact with the player, its primary weapons are yellow Happy Bombs, which are thrown in an arc, bounce off surfaces, and explode upon contact with the player or after their fuse timer runs out, dealing high damage but not destroying tiles. Clowns can also throw Chattering Teeth Bombs which chase the player and explode. Once the player has defeated at least one Clown in a world, the Clothier will start selling the Clown set. The Clown requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Clumsy Balloon Slime
description: 1.4.4 The Clumsy Balloon Slime is a rare entity that can be found in the Space layer, in any weather. In pre-Hardmode, it cannot spawn in the central vertical section of the map, which is around one-tenth the width of the entire map. This restriction is removed in Hardmode. The player can break its balloon as if it were an enemy, and then it will transform into the Clumsy Slime. Afterwards, the Clumsy Balloon Slime will no longer spawn.

name: Cochineal Beetle
description: The Cochineal Beetle is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It drops the Red Husk, which can be used to make Red Dye.

name: Corite
description: 1.3.0.1 The Corite is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. It is a flying enemy that shrouds itself in fire before charging toward the player at high speeds, all while traveling through blocks.

name: Corrupt Bunny
description: The Corrupt Bunny is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Bunny that has been corrupted, either by the player using Vile Powder on it or when a Bunny spawns during a Blood Moon in a Corruption world.

name: Corrupt Penguin
description: The Corrupt Penguin is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Penguin that has been corrupted, either by the player using Vile Powder on it or when a Penguin spawns during a Blood Moon in a Corruption world.

name: Corrupt Slime
description: The Corrupt Slime is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Corruption and Underground Corruption. It splits into two to three Slimelings upon death. Both its original form and the Slimelings have a chance of inflicting the Darkness debuff for 15 / 30 / 37.5 seconds.

name: Corruptor
description: The Corruptor is a Hardmode enemy that spawns within The Corruption and resembles a larger version of the Eater of Souls. It intermittently fires Vile Spit projectiles that inflict the Weak debuff.

name: Crab
description: The Crab is a weak pre-Hardmode enemy found in Oceans, walking along the bottom and occasionally jumping. They may also walk on land, and whether or not they are in water has no effect on their behavior.

name: Crawdad
description: 1.3.0.1 The Crawdad is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Cavern layer, and has two color variants that share identical stats and behavior. The Crawdad acts like a Crab, walking along the ground and jumping at the player when in close enough proximity, though it is slightly faster. It is also capable of moving through water unhindered. When a Crawdad is right next to the player, it will attack with its claw, dealing large amounts of damage per hit. Crawdads are unique in that their ability to spawn is connected to two other enemies: the Giant Shelly and the Salamander. Of these three enemies, a world will choose two types that it can spawn, leaving the third inaccessible. Crawdads will never spawn in a world that features both Giant Shellies and Salamanders together. This is taken into account by the Bestiary progression logic (the missing enemy will register as unlocked when the other two exclusive creatures are unlocked) and the acquisition (any two of the trio's banners can be used to craft the banner of the missing member of the trio).

name: Crawltipede
description: 1.3.0.1 The Crawltipede is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist, worm enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. Uniquely, it has no visible health bar, and its tail is the only segment that is vulnerable to attacks, which takes 10× damage. It flies directly at airborne players and deals high damage while ignoring players on the ground. The Crawltipede's primary role seems to be forcing the player to stay near the ground, opening them up to melee attacks from the other Solar Pillar enemies.

name: Creature from the Deep
description: 1.3.0.1 The Creature from the Deep is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It attacks like most other fighter-type enemies on land, but it also has the ability to swim in liquids. While swimming, its speed and maneuverability increase dramatically. It is also capable of jumping out of the water towards the player, doing so with maneuverability similar to a Unicorn.

name: Creeper
description: the Brain of Cthulhu's minion The Creeper is a pre-Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by the Brain of Cthulhu in a group of 20. They follow and orbit the Brain of Cthulhu, acting as a shield for it. Creepers do not respawn once they are killed. All Creepers must be destroyed first before the Brain of Cthulhu becomes vulnerable to attacks. Creepers have a chance to drop a Heart if the player is below full health (as opposed to for most enemies). On For the Worthy worlds, Creepers spawn in groups of 40.

name: Crimera
description: The Crimera is a common pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns predominantly in The Crimson. It is the Crimson counterpart to The Corruption's Eater of Souls, and behaves in the same manner, attacking by flying toward the player while circling them at a distance before periodically rushing in. Similar to Eater of Souls, Crimera can appear in three size variants: Little Crimera, Crimera, and Big Crimera, each with corresponding health, damage, and defense. The Little Crimera also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Shadewood or Shadewood Palm tree.

name: Crimslime
description: The Crimslime is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Crimson. It spawns with either 85%, 100%, or 115% of its usual size, with the stats altered accordingly. In the , it has a chance to inflict the Darkness debuff on contact.

name: Crimson Axe
description: the enemy The Crimson Axe is a Hardmode enemy which is found in the Underground Crimson. It hovers and spins before lunging at the player, traveling through any blocks to reach them. Any knockback stops its attack, forcing it to pause and spin up again. On the , it has a chance to inflict the Cursed debuff for 4 / 8 / 10 seconds.

name: Crystal Slime
description: 1.4.0.1 The Crystal Slime is a Hardmode slime and boss servant that is summoned by Queen Slime alongside Bouncy Slimes and Heavenly Slimes. It fires a Crystal Spike projectile every 0.83 seconds. In Expert Mode, it fires three projectiles at once every 0.42 seconds, but only if there are fewer than four other Crystal Slimes alive. Otherwise, it behaves like in Classic Mode.

name: Cultists
description: 1.3.0.1 The Cultists are Hardmode, post-Golem enemies that spawn along with a Mysterious Tablet at the entrance to the Dungeon after Golem has been defeated. Four Cultists will appear there: two Cultist Archers and two Lunatic Devotees. Defeating all four of the Cultists causes the Lunatic Cultist to spawn instantly at their location, destroying the Mysterious Tablet in the process. Defeating the Lunatic Cultist then initiates the Lunar Events. Until one of the Cultists is attacked, they are passive and deal no contact damage, and players can walk through them freely without activating them. Attacking any of the four will awaken the Archers, who will begin to fire Wooden Arrows using bows and will deal contact damage. Lunatic Devotees are always passive and never deal contact damage. All four Cultists respawn and reset their location and initial passive state after 12 minutes (12 in-game hours), if the Lunatic Cultist was not summoned, if the player runs away or dies during the fight, when all four Celestial Pillars are destroyed, or when the world is closed and restarted. Restarting the world can be the fastest option to reset them to their original state. The Lunatic Devotee and Cultist Archer require 25 kills to be awarded completion of their Bestiary entries and corresponding banners, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Cursed Hammer
description: The Cursed Hammer is a rare Hardmode enemy which spawns in the Underground Corruption. It hovers and spins before lunging at the player, traveling through any blocks to reach them. Any knockback stops its attack, forcing it to pause and spin up again. It can inflict the Cursed debuff.

name: Cursed Skull
description: The Cursed Skull is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns in the Dungeon. It is similar to the Meteor Head, with high damage, slow speed, and the ability to travel through tiles. It floats slowly towards the player, occasionally stopping to float in a circle around them for a while, before suddenly lunging forward to attack, similar to the Eye of Cthulhu. Upon striking a player, the Cursed Skull has a chance of inflicting the Cursed debuff for 4 / 8 / 10 seconds. This renders the player unable to use items, including weapons, potions, and hooks, making it very difficult to avoid taking further damage. Cursed Skulls spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by brick walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Cyan Beetle
description: The Cyan Beetle is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ice biome in the Cavern Layer. When killed, it will always drop the Cyan Husk, which can be used to craft Cyan Dye.

name: Dark Caster
description: The Dark Caster is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Dungeon. They follow the Caster AI, firing three Water Sphere projectiles before teleporting to another on-screen location. Water Spheres travel through walls but can be destroyed with a single hit from any weapon. The Dark Caster has a Red Hat variant summoned by the Red Hat Skeletron, with slightly different behavior (see Red Hat Skeletron for details).

name: Deadly Sphere
description: 1.3.0.1 the enemy The Deadly Sphere is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Upon spawning, it flies randomly in the direction of the player until it is within close enough proximity while traveling through blocks. Upon noticing the player, the Deadly Sphere grows spikes and begins to spin before rapidly charging toward them indefinitely while attempting to remain directly on top of them. While attacking the player, they are unable to charge through blocks.

name: Demon
description: Not to be confused with the Hardmode enemy, the Red Devil. The Demon is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in The Underworld. It attacks by summoning volleys of four spinning purple blades that gradually accelerate toward the player, which are similar to those fired by the Demon Scythe that it has a chance to drop. These blades deal high damage and have a chance to inflict the Darkness debuff for 15 / 30 / 37.5 seconds and are stopped by any block, but cannot be destroyed with weapons. Like other Underworld enemies, the Demon is immune to lava. A rarer variation of the Demon is the Voodoo Demon.

name: Demon Eye
description: Not to be confused with The Fish of Cthulhu, a quest fish that looks like a Demon Eye, or Demon's Eye, a painting found in the Underworld. The Demon Eye is a common pre-Hardmode flying enemy that appears in most surface biomes during nighttime, particularly in Forests. It has a slow turn rate, follows the player, and bounces off blocks. Its trajectory is changed when hit with a weapon that causes knockback.

name: Derpling
description: Not to be confused with the Herpling, a Hardmode surface The Crimson The Derpling is a [[Hardmode, insect-like enemy which spawns on the surface Jungle during the day in place of the Giant Flying Foxes which spawn at night. It jumps high, can strafe to the sides in mid-air, and attempts to land on top of the player. Derplings should be defeated quickly, as they spawn fast and can easily overwhelm the player.

name: Desert Spirit
biome: Underground Desert+Underground Corruption / Underground Desert+Underground Crimson
description: 1.3.0.1 The Desert Spirit is a Hardmode enemy that can be found in Corrupted or Crimson Underground Desert biomes. The Desert Spirit has an attack pattern that is unique compared to most enemies. Upon appearing near a player, it will begin casting 5 Desert Spirit's Curse projectiles that attempts to home in on the nearest player, phasing through blocks and slowly gaining speed. After , the projectiles will explode. The projectiles themselves do not deal any damage, but their explosions do. Similar to other casters, the Desert Spirit will finally teleport to a different location and repeat the process.

name: Devourer
description: Not to be confused with its Hardmode counterpart, the World Feeder. The Devourer is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy that spawns in the Corruption, though it is less common than the abundant Eaters of Souls. Like other worms, it attacks by burrowing through blocks to reach the player. The Devourer requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Diabolist
description: The Diabolist is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It attacks by firing Inferno Bolts at the player, which can travel through blocks. In addition to dealing direct damage to the player, the bolts also explode upon reaching where they were aimed at, creating a large flaming sphere that lasts for and deals massive damage on contact. Both the bolts and the spheres inflict the On Fire! debuff for 8–15 / 16–30 / 20–37.5 seconds. Diabolists teleport to a different location on-screen after firing three projectiles or upon being hit. Diabolists spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by tiled walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Digger
description: The Digger is a worm enemy that appears in the Underground and Cavern layers in Hardmode. On , it completely replaces the pre-Hardmode Giant Worm. On , Giant Worms still spawn rarely in Hardmode, but share kill count and banner with Diggers.

name: Doctor Bones
description: Doctor Bones is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that rarely appears in the Jungle and Underground Jungle at night. It acts the same as normal zombies, slowly walking towards the player to deal contact damage, while attempting to navigate around obstacles and only being able to open doors during a Blood Moon. It has significantly greater health than all other zombies and deals slightly higher damage. It drops the Archaeologist's Hat when killed. It does not have any variants, nor does it have an Armed variation in Expert Mode. Doctor Bones requires 10 kills to be awarded completion of his Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Dr. Man Fly
description: 1.3.0.1 Dr. Man Fly is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. He mainly attacks by throwing Toxic Flasks at the player, dealing area-of-effect damage. He gives the player a warning about an oncoming Toxic Flask attack by pausing in place. Like the Nailhead and Eyezor, they appear to traverse much slower than many of the other Solar Eclipse enemies, leaving the player enough time to plan a safe attack against them.

name: Drakanian
description: Celestial Tower The Drakanian is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist ground-based enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. It can originally spawn riding a Drakomire, forming a Drakomire Rider, and each can be separately killed. Killing the Drakomire first will cause the Drakanian to fully heal and attack the player.

name: Drakin
description: Old One's Army The Drakin is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 4–7, and Tier 3 during waves 3–7. The Drakin has a large amount of health and immunity to knockback and attacks by firing a barrage of six small purple Drakin Shot projectiles every second, making it a rather resilient and difficult enemy. The Drakin requires 100 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Drakomire
description: 1.3.0.1 The Drakomire is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist, ground-based enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. It periodically comes to a stop and shoots three Solar Flares at the player. Drakanians will occasionally spawn riding a Drakomire, resulting in a Drakomire Rider.

name: Drakomire Rider
description: 1.3.0.1 The Drakomire Rider is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that is a combination of a Drakanian and a Drakomire, and spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events.

name: Drippler
description: 1.3.0.1 The Drippler is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns during a Blood Moon. It hovers above the ground and floats slowly towards the player, but can be easily knocked back with most weapons.

name: Dune Splicer
description: 1.3.0.1 The Dune Splicer is a worm-type Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Desert, or much more commonly on the surface of the Desert during a Sandstorm. It is the Hardmode counterpart of the Tomb Crawler.

name: Dungeon Guardian
description: The Dungeon Guardian is an extremely dangerous and resilient enemy resembling Skeletron's head. If a player enters the Dungeon in a world where Skeletron has not been defeated and travels below zero depth (the border between the surface and underground layers), one or more Dungeon Guardians will spawn and quickly fly toward the player, dealing damage each, which will instantly kill most players if they are unprepared. Dungeon Guardians are large, very fast (traveling at around in all directions), and travel through all blocks. Because of the Dungeon Guardian's high defense (), any player who attacks it, regardless of the weapon or other equipment (with very few exceptions), will deal only 1 damage, or 2 for critical hits. This means that the Dungeon Guardian will normally take an average of 1.04 damage. While killing a Dungeon Guardian is possible (and will award the Bone Key pet summon), it requires careful preparation. See the Tips section for setups. The Dungeon Guardian's damage ignores dodge effects. The Dungeon Guardian's Bestiary entry will automatically fill itself out once Skeletron is defeated.

name: Dungeon Slime
description: The Dungeon Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Dungeon. It is an indigo-colored slime that contains a Golden Key inside, and always drops it when defeated. Unlike most other slimes, it does not drop Gel. It can spawn anywhere in the Dungeon, but appears less frequently than other Dungeon enemies.

name: Dungeon Spirit
description: The Dungeon Spirit is a flying Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It can only spawn when another enemy is defeated, having a / chance to rise from the enemy's remains. It can travel through blocks and drops Ectoplasm, which can be used to craft many Spectre-related items, as well as the Pumpkin Moon Medallion and Naughty Present.

name: Eater of Souls
description: the common enemy Not to be confused with the Corruptor, a Hardmode enemy that have similar appearance. The Eater of Souls is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns predominantly in The Corruption. It is the Corruption counterpart to The Crimson's Crimera. Eaters of Souls spawn from both Ebonstone and Corrupt grass, with large groups coming from chasms. They circle the player at a distance before periodically rushing in to deal contact damage. There are three size variants, each with corresponding amounts of health, defense, and damage. The Little Eater also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking an Ebonwood or Ebonwood Palm tree.

name: Elf Archer
description: The Elf Archer is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 2 of the Frost Moon event. She is very similar to the Pirate Crossbower, Goblin Archer, and Skeleton Archer, shooting Flaming Arrows which inflict the On Fire! debuff for 7 / 14 / 17.5 seconds. Defeating an Elf Archer during the Frost Moon event will add 3 / 6 / 7.5 points to the final score.

name: Elf Copter
description: The Elf Copter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 6 of the Frost Moon event. It travels through blocks, firing bullets rapidly at players within its line of sight. Defeating an Elf Copter during the Frost Moon event will add 8 / 16 / 20 points to the final score.

name: Enchanted Sword (NPC)
description: the enemy The Enchanted Sword is a Hardmode enemy which spawns in the Underground Hallow. It hovers and spins before lunging at the player, traveling through any blocks to reach them. Any damage dealt to it disrupts its attack, forcing it to pause and spin again. It has a chance of inflicting the Cursed debuff for 4 / 8 / 10 seconds upon contact.

name: Etherian Goblin
description: 1.3.4 The Etherian Goblin is an enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It is by far the event's most common enemy, spawning during every wave regardless of the current tier. The Etherian Goblin attacks by slowly approaching its target, hacking away with its weapon when it is close to the player or the Eternia Crystal, similar to Armed Zombies in Expert Mode. Like many other enemies from the event, its appearance and stats change depending on what point in the game the player has reached. Like most other ground-based enemies of the Old One's Army, if an Etherian Goblin's target is too far away or obstructed, it will enter an ethereal state, allowing it to pass through tiles. It is also unaffected by Teleporters or Lava. The Etherian Goblin requires 1,000 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Etherian Goblin Bomber
description: 1.3.4 The Etherian Goblin Bomber is an enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 1 during waves 2–5, Tier 2 during waves 3 and 5–7, and Tier 3 during waves 1–2 and 5–7. As its name implies, it attacks by hurling bouncy Goblin Bomb projectiles at its target, similar to Clowns. While they might not pose the biggest threat to players with decent equipment, they can easily gain the upper hand against an early-game defender, especially if the Tavernkeep was discovered directly after defeating the Eater of Worlds or Brain of Cthulhu. Like many other enemies from the event, its appearance and stats change, depending on what point in the game the player has reached. The Etherian Goblin Bomber requires 500 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Etherian Javelin Thrower
description: Old One's Army The Etherian Javelin Thrower is an enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 1 during waves 3–5, Tier 2 during waves 1–4 and 6–7, and Tier 3 during waves 1–4 and 6. As its name implies, the Etherian Javelin Thrower attacks by throwing javelins approximately every two seconds if it is within 37 tiles of the player or the Eternia Crystal. The Etherian Javelin Thrower requires 200 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Etherian Lightning Bug
description: Old One's Army The Etherian Lightning Bug is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 3 in waves 2 and 6. Upon gaining line of sight with the player, an Etherian Lightning Bug flies towards them and attempts to position itself slightly beyond the melee reach of the player (or a distance less than 10 tiles away from the player). Afterward, it fires short-ranged Withering Bolts approximately once every half second which deal high damage and inflict the Withered Weapon debuff, which halves player-inflicted damage for 5 seconds. It is one of only two enemies from the Old One's Army that requires the usual 50 kills to obtain its corresponding banner, the other being the Wither Beast.

name: Etherian Wyvern
description: 1.3.4 The Etherian Wyvern is a flying enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 1 during waves 4–5, Tier 2 during waves 3–7, and Tier 3 during waves 3–4. The Etherian Wyvern passes through all solid blocks and flies fairly high above the player or the Eternia Crystal before diving towards its closest target. This causes it to dip below the surface of blocks, making it somewhat difficult to hit without weapons that can attack through blocks. The Etherian Wyvern can attack approximately once every 1.5 seconds, and periodically lets out a screech as it is diving at a target. Additionally, Betsy can also summon a maximum of nine Tier 3 Etherian Wyverns during her roar attack. The Etherian Wyvern requires 200 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Evolution Beast
description: 1.3.0.1 The Evolution Beast is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events. It attacks by shooting a slow, homing Nebula Sphere and attempting to ram the player.

name: Eyezor
description: The Eyezor is an uncommon Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event, and primarily attacks by advancing toward the player while firing high-velocity purple laser beams at them. It also travels faster than normal Zombies and is highly resistant to knockback. As the Eyezor takes damage, its movement speed and the rate at which it fires lasers will increase.

name: Face Monster
description: The Face Monster is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be found in The Crimson. It follows the Fighter AI, being able to open doors at any time. Like other Crimson enemies, it drops Vertebra fairly often.

name: Fire Imp
description: The Fire Imp is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underworld. It fires Burning Spheres, which travel through blocks and have a chance to inflict the On Fire! debuff for 7 / 14 / 17.5 seconds. The Burning Spheres can easily be destroyed by hitting them with any weapon, minion, or damage-dealing tool or pet. Like all casters, the Fire Imp will follow the pattern of firing three times, pausing for several seconds, and teleporting to another location on the screen.

name: Floaty Gross
description: The Floaty Gross is a floating Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Crimson. It can float through blocks in a manner similar to Wraiths and has a to inflict the Weak debuff for 2 / 4 / 5 minutes upon contact with the player. Because of its low knockback resistance and ability to pass through walls, weapons with high knockback will be more effective against it in the narrow crevices of the Underground Crimson.

name: Flocko
description: The Flocko is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 11 of the Frost Moon event. Flockos tend to spawn along with the Ice Queen and attack by flying toward the player while spinning at high speed. Defeating a Flocko during the Frost Moon event will add 5 / 10 / 12.5 points to the current score.

name: Flow Invader
description: 1.3.0.1 The Flow Invader is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. When it spawns, three smaller minions will appear one at a time and begin orbiting it. The Flow Invader uses these as attacks, launching them as high-speed projectiles towards the player. The orbiting minions will reappear over time. The Flow Invader will launch all of its remaining minions at the player upon death.

name: Flying Fish
description: The Flying Fish is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns when the weather is rainy in any surface biome. It follows a path much like the Eater of Souls, but has relatively low movement speed. Unlike most other flying enemies, it is able to freely enter water. Flying Fish will ignore players not in their line of sight, e.g. behind a wall or under a roof.

name: Flying Snake
description: The Flying Snake is a flying enemy that spawns in the Jungle Temple. Its only spawning requirement is that the player stands in front of unsafe Lihzahrd Brick Walls. The Flying Snake flies directly towards nearby players and deals contact damage, identically to a Bat.

name: Frankenstein
description: Frankenstein is a Hardmode enemy that commonly spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Frankensteins behave similarly to Zombies, but have increased stats.

name: Fritz
description: 1.3.0.1 Fritz is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It moves very quickly on the ground and leaps into players to attack.

name: Frozen Zombie
description: The Frozen Zombie is a Zombie variant that only appears on the Surface Snow biome at night. It acts the same as normal Zombies, slowly walking towards the player to deal contact damage, while attempting to navigate around obstacles and only being able to open doors during a Blood Moon. It is differentiated from other Zombies in that it is dressed in a light blue snow suit, which it can drop as armor pieces in the form of the Snow Hood, Snow Coat, and Snow Pants. Like normal Zombies, it has an armed variation in Expert Mode, which can perform a "slashing" attack when close to the player to deal extra damage with increased range.

name: Fungi Bulb
description: The Fungi Bulb is an uncommon enemy found in Glowing Mushroom biomes above the surface. During Hardmode, they can also appear in Underground Glowing Mushroom biomes. The Fungi Bulb follows the plant behavior akin to the Man Eater, but is less aggressive. Unlike its tougher Hardmode variant, the Giant Fungi Bulb, it does not fire spore projectiles.

name: Gastropod
description: The Gastropod is a flying Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns frequently on the surface of The Hallow at night. If the player is within its line of sight, it will open its shell and fire high-velocity Pink Lasers which emit faint pink light.

name: Ghost (enemy)
description: Not to be confused with the Ghost, the form Hardcore players take after dying. The Ghost is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer during the Halloween seasonal event. On the , Ghosts will also spawn in the Graveyard mini-biome in Surface and cavern layers, regardless of time, and have a chance to spawn when breaking Tombstones. Ghosts behave like Wraiths, hovering above the ground and passing through solid tiles to reach the player. In order for Ghosts to travel up to players, they must have a solid block to pass through, or else they will stay hovering just above the ground.

name: Giant Bat
description: The Giant Bat is a Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It can inflict the Confused debuff for 5 / 10 / 12.5 seconds, and also has a chance to inflict the Feral Bite debuff in Expert Mode for 30–90 seconds. It appears much larger than a normal Cave Bat.

name: Giant Cursed Skull
description: The Giant Cursed Skull is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It acts similarly to the Cursed Skull in flight pattern, except it is much larger and will occasionally shoot "Shadowflames", high-velocity white blasts that pass through tiles. On the , it has a chance to inflict the Cursed debuff upon contact, while its projectiles always inflict the debuff, which lasts for 4 / 8 / 10 seconds. Giant Cursed Skulls spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by slab or tiled walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Giant Flying Fox
description: The Giant Flying Fox is a Hardmode bat enemy that spawns only on the surface of the Jungle at night. In Expert Mode, it can inflict the Feral Bite debuff.

name: Giant Shelly
description: 1.3.0.1 The Giant Shelly is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Cavern layer, and has two color variants that share identical stats and behavior. The Giant Shelly walks around slowly and occasionally curls into its shell. It then starts spinning and hurls itself at the player, gaining increased defense and dealing high contact damage. Giant Shellies attack very quickly and deal high damage compared to other enemies for the stage in the game where they are found. Giant Shellies are unique in that their ability to spawn is connected to two other enemies: the Crawdad and the Salamander. Of these three enemies, a world will choose two types that it can spawn, leaving the third inaccessible. Giant Shellies will never spawn in a world that features both Crawdads and Salamanders together. This is taken into account by the Bestiary progression logic (the missing enemy will register as unlocked when the other two exclusive creatures are unlocked) and the acquisition (any two of the trio's banners can be used to craft the banner of the missing member of the trio).

name: Giant Tortoise
description: The Giant Tortoise is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle and Underground Jungle. It walks around slowly, and occasionally retracts into its shell. It then starts spinning and hurls itself at the player, gaining increased defense and dealing high contact damage. It drops Turtle Shells, which are vital for crafting Turtle armor. A functionally identical variant of the Giant Tortoise, the Ice Tortoise, can be encountered in the Ice biome.

name: Giant Worm
description: The Giant Worm is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy that spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and tunnels through blocks to attack the player. It makes a distinctive shuffling sound that grows louder and more rapid as it approaches the player, providing an indicator of its presence and proximity. It also leaves behind a subtle particle effect in its trail. On versions, it only spawns in pre-Hardmode and is replaced by the Digger in Hardmode.

name: Gigazapper
description: 1.3.0.1 The Gigazapper is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that appears during the Martian Madness event. It uses a short-ranged electrical spear weapon unavailable to players, with a maximum fire rate of once every half of a second. Its projectiles shock the player, inflicting the Electrified debuff for 4–8 seconds, causing the player to lose health rapidly.

name: Gingerbread Man
description: Not to be confused with the Gingerbread Cookie, a food item. The Gingerbread Man is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Frost Moon event. He is much like the Splinterling but drops no items. Defeating a Gingerbread Man during the Frost Moon event will add 2 / 4 / 5 points to the current score.

name: Gnome
description: 1.4.0.1 The Gnome is an uncommon pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns around the surface, and spawns more commonly in Living Trees. When it is not behind a background wall on the surface during the daytime, it will turn into a Garden Gnome which increases the luck of nearby players. The Gnome requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Goblin Archer
description: The Goblin Archer is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It fires Wooden Arrows at players within its line of sight while stationary. Its attacks can be interrupted by knocking it back. Goblin Archers will also spawn alongside the distressed Cattiva and Foxparks, and must be defeated before the Pals turn into their item forms.

name: Goblin Peon
description: The Goblin Peon is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It is the event's most basic enemy and follows the Fighter AI. Approximately one out of every five goblins will be a Peon (17.8% chance to spawn). It has the unique ability to destroy doors that are in its way (destroyed doors drop as collectible items). The Goblin Peon is only two tiles tall (instead of the 3-tile player height) and can fit through smaller gaps in the player's walls.

name: Goblin Scout
description: The Goblin Scout is an uncommon pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface in the farthest edges of the player's world. It appears to be an enemy from the Goblin Army event, but it spawns during ordinary gameplay. The Tattered Cloth it drops is a component for the Goblin Battle Standard, which summons a Goblin Army. Goblin Scouts can only be found in the furthest east and furthest west sixths of the world. They will not spawn on Sand Blocks or on blocks infected by The Corruption, The Crimson or The Hallow and will only spawn during the day.

name: Goblin Sorcerer
description: The Goblin Sorcerer is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. Approximately one out of every nine goblins will be a Sorcerer (11.11% chance to spawn). The Goblin Sorcerer fires three Chaos Balls in succession that travel through blocks before it teleports. The Sorcerer cannot fire and will not teleport when taking damage.

name: Goblin Thief
description: The Goblin Thief is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It follows the typical Fighter AI but moves at a higher speed than similar enemies. Goblin Thieves can jump high and open Tall Gate faster than other fighters. Approximately one out of every six goblins will be a Thief (15.8% chance to spawn).

name: Goblin Warlock
description: 1.3.0.1 The Goblin Warlock is a Hardmode enemy that rarely spawns during the Goblin Army event. Because of her high stats and relatively high difficulty compared to other goblins, she will present a challenge for new Hardmode players. Defeating her, however, rewards the player with weapons that are themed after Shadowflame, all of which accordingly inflict the Shadowflame debuff. The Goblin Warlock initially seems to behave like a typical Fighter AI enemy, though once she is close enough to the player, she will summon a Shadowflame Apparition above herself before flying directly upwards. She will not stop her ascent until she is above the player, at which point she will then dash over towards the player's current position before slowly gliding towards the ground in a somewhat rectangular flight pattern. The Goblin Warlock also flies towards the player if they move too far away from her and passes through any solid blocks in her path. If she is hovering at any time, she will fire Chaos Balls approximately once every half-second, which can be destroyed by any weapon or projectile. The Goblin Warlock requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of her Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Goblin Warrior
description: The Goblin Warrior is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Goblin Army event. It follows the Fighter AI and is the most commonly encountered enemy in the event. Approximately one out of every three goblins will be a Warrior (31.6% chance to spawn). Like many other enemies that follow the Fighter AI, Goblin Warriors can open doors and Tall Gate.

name: Golden Slime
description: 1.4.2.3 The Golden Slime is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant found in Celebration Mk 10 and Zenith worlds. It spawns in Forests, as well as in the Underground and Cavern layers, similarly to Pinky. It hops more frequently than normal slimes and emits golden sparkles around itself. When hit, it releases several cosmetic coins.

name: Granite Elemental
description: 1.3.0.1 the enemy in Granite Caves The Granite Elemental is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Granite Caves and floats towards the player. In Expert Mode, Granite Elementals have a chance to shield themselves and drop to the ground defensively when attacked, making them immune to all damage for before they begin hovering again. Granite Elementals always drop Granite Blocks upon death, like Granite Golems. They can also rarely drop the Night Vision Helmet.

name: Granite Golem
description: 1.3.0.1 the enemy in Granite Caves The Granite Golem is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Granite Caves. Every , it will stand still and shield itself from all attacks for , making it completely invulnerable. It can still deal damage to players during this invulnerable state should they walk into it. Like the Granite Elemental, it will always drop a small amount of Granite Blocks. It can also rarely drop the Night Vision Helmet.

name: Gray Grunt
description: 1.3.0.1 The Gray Grunt is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. While outwardly similar to most Martian enemies, it is unique in that it is completely invulnerable to knockback.

name: Green Slime
description: The Green Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that commonly spawns in Forest biomes during the daytime. It is the weakest slime and also one of the most common ones to encounter, likely making it the first enemy a player will come across in a new world. Green Slimes will not target the player under usual circumstances, but will become aggressive when damaged, during the night, or if brought underground.

name: Harpy
description: The Harpy is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that spawns in Space and at high altitudes, typically around Floating Islands. They move following the Bat AI, and fire slow-moving blue feather projectiles in inaccurate bursts of three. Prior to Hardmode, they cannot spawn in the central vertical section of the map, which is one-tenth the width of the entire map. This restriction is removed in Hardmode. Up to seven Harpies can exist on-screen during the day, ten at night, and fifteen during a Blood Moon.

name: Headless Horseman
description: The Headless Horseman is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 5 / wave 9 of the Pumpkin Moon event. He is an exceptionally dangerous enemy due to his speed, high contact damage, and immunity to knockback. The Headless Horseman attacks by charging forward and doing a low, quick jump to reach the player. Additionally, on the , the Headless Horseman can also throw a Pumpkin Head projectile, which moves in a wavelike manner and homes into the player for an extended period of time. Defeating a Headless Horseman during the Pumpkin Moon event will add 50 / 100 / 125 / 25 points to the final score.

name: Heavenly Slime
description: 1.4.0.1 The Heavenly Slime is a Hardmode slime and boss servant that is summoned by Queen Slime alongside Crystal Slimes and Bouncy Slimes. It flies around trying to ram into the player.

name: Hell Armored Bones
description: The Hell Armored Bones is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawn in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Similar to Angry Bones, they come in multiple varieties and follow the Fighter AI. Hell Armored Bones are visible in darkness but do not actually emit light, except for a faint glow when immersed in water. They also inflict the On Fire! debuff for 10 / 20 / 25 seconds. Hell Armored Bones spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by tiled walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Hellbat
description: The Hellbat is a pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in The Underworld. Although they cannot fly underwater or through lava, they take no damage from making contact with either. In the Zenith (seed) special world seed, it drops lava upon death.

name: Hellhound
description: The Hellhound is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 3 of the Pumpkin Moon event. Hellhounds follow the Unicorn AI and run and leap towards the player to deal contact damage; the player will be barely able to outrun them with boots or similar movement accessories, thus attacking them while out of their reach is important while fighting them. Defeating a Hellhound during the Pumpkin Moon event will add 5 / 10 / 15 / 4 points to the final score. The Hellhound requires 100 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Herpling
description: Not to be confused with the Derpling, a Hardmode surface Jungle enemy. The Herpling is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Crimson. It attacks the player by quickly jumping across the ground. While it cannot jump very high, it can cover horizontal distance very quickly, making it a potent threat.

name: Hoplite
description: 1.3.0.1 The Hoplite is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Marble Caves. It throws piercing Javelins at the player, which deals immense damage, especially in Expert Mode or Master Mode. The Javelins they throw are also fairly accurate and are more likely to hit the player than most other enemy-fired projectiles. This makes the Hoplite an enemy to avoid early on in the game until players are properly equipped and ready to face them.

name: Hoppin' Jack
description: The '''Hoppin' Jack''' is a Hardmode enemy that will only appear at night during the Halloween seasonal event, or in Graveyard at any time of year. He attacks by hopping towards the player in a manner identical to most slimes. The Hoppin' Jack becomes significantly quicker after he loses any health. Notably, despite using the Slime AI, he is not treated as a slime for most other purposes. Hoppin' Jack drops no Gel on death, will still attack the player even if they have the Royal Gel equipped, and killing one is not necessary to earn the Gelatin World Tour () or Slimer/King of Slimes () achievements.

name: Hornet
description: Not to be confused with the Moss Hornet, a similar Hardmode enemy. The Hornet is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy found in the Underground Jungle. They follow the Flying AI, floating just out of reach and then charging the player, while also firing stinger projectiles (at an increased rate in Expert Mode). The stingers cannot be destroyed with weapons and travel at about the same speed as the darts from a Dart Trap. Stingers have a chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff on the player for 10 seconds. In Expert Mode, the chance is for 20 seconds and for 2–10 seconds.

name: Ice Bat
description: The Ice Bat is a pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in the Ice biome. It inflicts the Chilled debuff and, more rarely, the Frozen debuff. Additionally, it emits a very faint glow.

name: Ice Elemental
description: the enemy from the Snow and Ice biome The Ice Elemental is a Hardmode enemy that appears in the Snow biome at night and in the Ice biome at any time. The Ice Elemental slowly hovers towards the player and shoots Frost Blasts which, on , have a chance to inflict the Frostburn debuff for 6 / 12 / 15 seconds.

name: Ice Golem
description: the rare, resilient enemy found in the Snow biome during Blizzards The Ice Golem is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow biome during Blizzards. The Ice Golem walks slowly, and, when it has a clear line of sight with the player, fires high-velocity Frost Beam projectiles that chill and occasionally freeze them in place. Its movement speed and the rate at which it fires beams increase exponentially the further its health is depleted. It has a guaranteed chance to drop a Frost Core, the main ingredient for the Frost armor, Cool Whip, and Blizzard in a Bottle. The Ice Golem requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Ice Slime
description: The Ice Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Snow biome during the daytime. Upon contact with the player, it has a chance to inflict the Chilled debuff, if the player is not already inflicted with the Frozen debuff.

name: Ice Tortoise
description: The Ice Tortoise is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ice biome. It walks around slowly, and occasionally retracts into its shell. It then starts spinning and hurls itself at the player, gaining increased defense and dealing high contact damage. A functionally identical variant of the Ice Tortoise, the Giant Tortoise, can be encountered in the Jungle and Underground Jungle.

name: Ichor Sticker
description: The Ichor Sticker is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Crimson and floats around in the air. When tracking the player, it spits a stream of Ichor at them, similar to that of the Golden Shower. The stream inflicts the Ichor debuff for 15 / 30 / 37.5 seconds, lowering the player's defense by 15 / 20. Upon death, Ichor Stickers will also drop Ichor.

name: Icy Merman
description: The Icy Merman is a Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome. Upon gaining line of sight of the player, it will stop in place and begin firing Icewater Spit projectiles similar to those fired by the Frost Staff, but with less frequency. Its projectiles also behave similarly to those of the Ice Elemental, but deal less damage and are fired more rapidly. The Icewater Spit attack always inflicts the Chilled debuff, and has a chance to inflict Frozen.

name: Illuminant Bat
description: The Illuminant Bat is a Hardmode bat enemy that only spawns in the Underground Hallow. It is the Hallowed version of the Giant Bat, but is much stronger and emits a blurred, after-image effect.

name: Illuminant Slime
description: The Illuminant Slime is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground Hallow, replacing normal cave slimes (Black and Mother Slimes) in most cases. Compared to its pre-Hardmode counterparts, it deals much more damage and has more health. The Illuminant Slime gives off a small amount of light and leaves an after-image (like the Chaos Elemental and Illuminant Bat), which appears as a long, pink trail.

name: Jungle Bat
description: The Jungle Bat is a common pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in the Jungle and less commonly in the Underground Jungle. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Mahogany tree at night. In Expert Mode, it can inflict the Feral Bite debuff. Like most other bats, it cannot enter water.

name: Jungle Creeper
description: The Jungle Creeper is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Jungle. Like other spiders, it can climb on background walls. On the , it has a chance to inflict the Acid Venom debuff for 4 / 8 / 10 seconds. Additionally in Expert Mode, it gains a special spit attack that inflicts the Webbed debuff for 0.5–2.5 seconds.

name: Jungle Slime
description: The Jungle Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that only spawns in the Jungle during the daytime. They have relatively high damage and health compared to most other slimes in the early game. Notably, Jungle Slimes drop a much larger amount of coins than any common slime prior to Hardmode.

name: Kobold
description: Old One's Army The Kobold is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 2–7, and Tier 3 during waves 2–5. When it is near the player or the Eternia Crystal, it will emote a speech bubble with an exclamation mark, light its fuse, and begin screaming while dashing towards the nearest target. When it reaches a target, it kills itself and creates an explosion with a radius similar to that of a Grenade. The detonation will not destroy tiles, also similar to a Grenade. Like other members of the Old One's Army, if a Kobold's target is too far away or obstructed, it will enter an ethereal state, allowing it to float upwards and pass through tiles. Kobolds are also unaffected by Teleporters or Lava, and will take half damage from Traps. The Kobold requires 200 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Kobold Glider
description: Old One's Army The Kobold Glider is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 5–7, and Tier 3 during waves 4–5. When it is close to or below the player or the Eternia Crystal, it will briefly spin upwards before lighting its fuse and diving towards its closest target, effectively turning itself into a homing missile. Upon contact with the player, Eternia Crystal, or solid blocks, it will detonate with a radius similar to that of a Grenade. The explosion cannot destroy tiles. The Kobold Glider requires 100 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Krampus
description: The Krampus is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 8 of the Frost Moon event. Defeating a Krampus during the Frost Moon event will add 10 / 20 / 25 points to the final score.

name: Lac Beetle
description: The Lac Beetle is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Jungle. When killed, it will drop the Violet Husk, which can be used to make Violet Dye.

name: Lamia
description: 1.3.0.1 The Lamia is a Hardmode enemy that can only be found in the Underground Desert biome. When found in regular or Hallowed Underground Deserts, it has pale blonde hair and has a chance to drop the Sun Mask. Corruption/Crimson Underground Deserts will spawn an alternate variant having much darker hair than its normal counterpart. The "corrupted" version has a chance to drop the Moon Mask. Both variants have a rare chance to drop a piece of the Lamia set.

name: Lava Bat
description: The Lava Bat is a Hardmode bat enemy that appears in the Underworld after one of the mechanical bosses has been defeated. It is a stronger version of the Hellbat. In the Zenith (seed) special world seed, it drops lava upon death.

name: Lava Slime
description: The Lava Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Underworld. It gives off an orange glow with fire particles. Lava Slimes take no damage from lava and float on it like regular slimes do on water, except they rebound very high into the air when they come up, instead of gently bouncing up and down like normal slimes. Lava Slimes also have increased mobility compared to other slimes. Unlike most slimes, the Lava Slime does not drop Gel upon death but still drops coins. In Expert Mode, lava slimes leave behind a small amount of lava when killed, which usually (but not always) destroys any coins that are dropped. The coins can be recovered consistently if the player is close enough to pick them up when the slime dies, because items that are in the process of being picked up become immune to lava. The amount of lava produced by each slime randomly varies from 19.6% to 58.8% of a full tile. Since the minimum amount of fluid required to fill a bucket (which holds one tile of liquid) is 39.2% of a full tile, this means the lava dropped from one slime is bucketable around half the time.

name: Leech
description: The Leech is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy and boss servant that is summoned by the Wall of Flesh. Multiple Leeches are released from the Wall's mouth, first in groups of 3-4. The groups grow larger and more frequent as the boss takes damage. The Wall of Flesh will eventually release them in a continuous stream.

name: Librarian Skeleton
description: 1.4.5.0 The Librarian Skeleton is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in front of placed Books in the Dungeon. It teleports around the player, preferably near books, and attacks by throwing nearby books at the player, which go through blocks. A bright sigil shows behind the enemy as it attacks.

name: Lihzahrd
description: The Lihzahrd is an enemy that spawns in the Jungle Temple and initially behaves like an ordinary walking fighter. However, as soon as its health is reduced to below 55% ( / / ), it enters its second, crawling form, causing it appear like a more lizard-like quadrupedal creature. In this form, the Lihzahrd is much faster, gains additional damage and defense, and becomes immune to knockback, but has reduced jump height.

name: Maggot Zombie
description: 1.4.0.1 The Maggot Zombie is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that spawns in the Graveyard mini-biome. When a Maggot Zombie is killed, up to three Maggots will be spawned. Maggot Zombies have a more dreadful and rotten appearance than other Zombies, and is implied that it is missing an eye, due to its sprite depicting a Maggot crawling through it.

name: Man Eater
description: The Man Eater is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Underground Jungle, and is nearly identical in appearance and behavior to the above-ground Snatcher. Man Eaters spawn anchored to blocks, with an extendable stem topped by a pincher. The stem itself is a passive component and can be walked through safely without incurring damage; only the pincher inflicts or takes damage.

name: Martian Drone
description: 1.3.0.1 Not to be confused with the Martian Probe. The Martian Drone is a Hardmode, post-Golem flying enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It can move through solid blocks, and when it is positioned lower than the player, flies directly towards a point just above the player. After reaching this point, or the player is positioned lower than the Martian Drone, it will dive down towards the player. Once it gets close enough to the player, it self-destructs, dealing area-of-effect damage. Martian Drones do not contribute progress towards the Martian Madness event if they self-destruct.

name: Martian Engineer
description: 1.3.0.1 The Martian Engineer is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that appears during the Martian Madness event. Martian Engineers have the ability to build Tesla Turrets around them.

name: Martian Officer
description: 1.3.0.1 The Martian Officer is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It will always initially spawn with a protective Bubble Shield, which provides the Officer significantly added defense and hit points, as well as immunity to lava and knockback, until it is depleted. After the Bubble Shield is destroyed, the Officer can now actually be harmed. If the Martian Officer is not killed within three seconds after the Bubble Shield is depleted, the Bubble Shield will reactivate with full strength. The Officer's health will not be restored.

name: Martian Probe
description: 1.3.0.1 The Martian Probe is a rare Hardmode, post-Golem flying enemy that can spawn above the surface in the outer two thirds of the world, most commonly in the Space layers. The Martian Probe initially appears with a green light. When it detects the player, the light turns red, it gains the ability to pass through blocks, and attempts to escape. If allowed to, it initiates the Martian Madness event.

name: Martian Walker
description: Martian Madness The Martian Walker is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It appears as a large tripod enemy that moves at a very fast pace and fires rapid barrages of blue Laser Rays at the player.

name: Medusa
description: 1.3.0.1 Not to be confused with Mechdusa, a special world seed-exclusive boss. Medusa is a Hardmode enemy found near Marble Caves, and is a relatively fast-moving melee attacker who has the unique ability to inflict the Stoned debuff through her gaze. This debuff deals 20 / 40 / 60 damage to the player and petrifies them, turning them into stone. * The player will be unable to move or use items for the duration of the debuff, similar to the Frozen debuff. * Fall damage-negating accessories are disabled, fall damage is increased, and the minimum distance for fall damage to occur is reduced. The debuff's onset is marked by Medusa's snake hair (as well as Medusa herself) lashing out red tongues, accompanied by a unique noise and a yellow particle effect, giving players notice before they are petrified. Players can avoid getting Stoned by facing the other direction when the animation completes, or by having Medusa's line of sight blocked by solid blocks. The less health Medusa has, the faster she will move, similar to Mummies. Her speed increases linearly from at full health to just before dying.

name: Meteor Head
description: The Meteor Head is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that only spawns in a Meteorite biome. They override all other enemy spawns in the biome, except the Ocean biome. Once only 74 blocks of Meteorite remain, the area is no longer considered a Meteorite biome. Therefore, Meteor Heads will no longer spawn. Meteor Heads follow the Flying AI, and slowly float towards the player while passing through solid blocks. They inflict large amounts of damage upon contact with the player, and have a chance of inflicting the On Fire! debuff for 7 / 14 / 17.5 seconds.

name: Milkyway Weaver
description: 1.3.0.1 The Milkyway Weaver is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist, worm enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It is similar to the Solar Pillar's Crawltipede, in that it is completely unaffected by gravity and floats freely through the air. However, it is much smaller than the Crawltipede, targets players anywhere instead of only in the air, and rather than its tail, its head is its only vulnerable part. While the Milkyway Weaver attacks primarily by trying to charge towards the player to inflict contact damage, it slows down after chasing the player for . During this time, it charges up for while emitting an increasingly bright blue glimmer before summoning certain Stardust Pillar enemies in a constellation pattern, similar to the Stardust Pillar's own summoning attack. It resumes chasing the player after summoning an enemy and repeats its attack cycle.

name: Mimics
description: enemies disguising as Chests Mimics are rare Hardmode enemies disguised as Chests, appearing as the appropriate chest type for the environment. Mimics can be spawned by the player using the Chest Statue, even in pre-Hardmode. However, Mimics spawned this way only drop the Mimic Banner. Rarer Corrupt, Crimson, and Hallowed Mimics can also be spawned manually by players via a Key of Light or Key of Night (see the Biome Mimic section below). They are some of the few entities that can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer or its upgrades. Corrupt, Crimson, and Hallowed Mimics require 25 kills to be awarded completion of their Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Mister Stabby
description: Mister Stabby is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Frost Legion event. It chases the player and occasionally stops in place to do a considerably long stabbing animation with its knife. When attacking the player, it will dash and bounce around the terrain, making it difficult to hit.

name: Moss Hornet
description: Not to be confused with the Hornet, a similar pre-Hardmode enemy. The Moss Hornet is a Hardmode flying enemy similar to the pre-Hardmode Hornet, being encountered in the Underground Jungle biome and requiring blocks of Jungle grass in order to spawn. Compared to the more random flying patterns of pre-Hardmode Hornets, Moss Hornets act more aggressively, hovering closer to the player's position and shooting their stingers in rapid bursts. The stingers have a chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff to the player for 10 seconds. In Expert Mode, the chance is for 20 seconds and for 2–10 seconds. They cannot be destroyed with weapons and travel at about the same speed as the darts from a Dart Trap. Moss Hornets have a / chance to drop the Tattered Bee Wing. On the , the Tattered Bee Wing will only drop once any mechanical boss has been defeated in the current world.

name: Moss Zombie
description: 1.4.5.0 The Moss Zombie is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that spawns in a surface Graveyard mini-biome if the player has negative luck.

name: Moth
description: Not to be confused with Mothron, the Solar Eclipse enemy. The Moth is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Jungle. It flies around very slowly, and upon seeing the player, will direct its attention towards them and attempt to deal contact damage. Upon killing a Moth, there is a chance that it will drop Butterfly Dust, which is solely used to craft Butterfly Wings. On the , the Butterfly Dust can only drop once any mechanical boss has been defeated in the current world. The Moth requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Mother Slime
