description: The Mother Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Cavern layer. Upon death, it spawns 1-3 Baby Slimes, and like all slimes, drops Gel. It is one of the largest ordinary slimes in the game, only topped by King Slime, Queen Slime, and the Rainbow Slime.

name: Mothron
description: 1.3.0.1 Mothron is a rare, powerful, Hardmode, post-Plantera, flying enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Mothron can pass through all blocks and attacks by chasing after the player or aligning itself horizontally with them before lunging towards them at varying speeds, inflicting heavy contact damage depending on its velocity. Occasionally, it lands on blocks to lay several Mothron Eggs that spawn Baby Mothrons if they are not destroyed in time, much like Lepus. Mothron requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Mushi Ladybug
description: For the critter, see Ladybug. The Mushi Ladybug is an enemy that spawns in Glowing Mushroom biomes, both on the surface and below-ground in Hardmode, but only on the surface in pre-Hardmode. The Mushi Ladybug's high health and damage, quick movement, and ability to fly short distances place them among the more dangerous enemies that can spawn before Hardmode.

name: Mysterious Portal
description: Old One's Army The Mysterious Portal is an invincible NPC spawned during the Old One's Army event. Two Mysterious Portals will spawn when the event starts, at a minimum of 61 tiles and a maximum of 120 tiles away from the Eternia Crystal Stand on both sides, and they cannot be destroyed conventionally by the player. They are responsible for spawning all the enemies during the event, and will only despawn upon the event's completion or failure.

name: Mysterious Tablet
description: Cultists The Mysterious Tablet is an invincible NPC which spawns at the entrance of the Dungeon after Golem is defeated. Players cannot interact with it in any way, as it serves only as a graphical prop for the Cultists' ritual and the spawning of the Lunatic Cultist. The Mysterious Tablet spawns surrounded by four initially passive Cultists, two of them being Lunatic Devotees and the others being Cultist Archers. Once all four Cultists are killed, the Lunatic Cultist spawns, destroying the Tablet and starting its boss fight. The Mysterious Tablet will respawn (including the Cultists) after 12 minutes (12 in-game hours), if the player runs away or dies during the Lunatic Cultist fight, when all four Celestial Pillars are destroyed, or when the world is closed and restarted. Restarting the world can be the fastest option to reset the Tablet and the Cultists to their original state.

name: Nailhead
description: 1.3.0.1 The Nailhead is an uncommon Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. In addition to dealing high contact damage, the Nailhead has a chance to fire three to five Nail projectiles in a wide spread when attacked. He has significantly more health than most other Solar Eclipse enemies and has a high resistance to knockback. The Nailhead requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of his Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Nebula Floater
description: Lunar Events The Nebula Floater is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events. The Nebula Floater periodically spawns up to three Nebula Eyes that float around it. If it has a clear line of sight to the player, it will hover in place and start firing pink Nebula Lasers from one of the Nebula Eyes at the player, otherwise, it will move towards the player through all tiles. It can also do random teleports around the player periodically, and will also attempt to do so with a small chance if it is hit.

name: Necromancer
description: The Necromancer is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It attacks by rapidly firing Shadow Beams at the player, thin rays of purple light that reflect off walls multiple times. These rays are instantaneous and inflict the Slow debuff for 5–15 / 10–30 / 12.5–37.5 seconds. Necromancers teleport to a different location on-screen after firing projectiles five times or with a chance upon being hit. Necromancers spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by brick walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Nutcracker
description: The Nutcracker is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 3 of the Frost Moon event. There are two Nutcracker variants, each with slightly differing damage and defense. The first variant will transform into the more powerful second variant when its health is reduced to below 55% ( / / ). The Nutcracker's spinning second form gains a higher resistance to knockback and significantly increased movement speed. Defeating a Nutcracker during the Frost Moon event will add 4 / 8 / 10 points to the final score.

name: Nymph
description: .]] The Nymph is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer of any biome. When encountered, she appears as the Lost Girl, who seems to be a helpless, stationary NPC in need of rescue. However, when a player gets close or attacks the Lost Girl, she transforms into the Nymph and starts attacking the player by running towards them. For a pre-Hardmode enemy, she deals comparatively high damage. The Lost Girl will only transform into a Nymph if any of the following conditions are met: * The Lost Girl does not have full health. * The distance between the player and the Lost Girl is less than 12.5 tiles, and she has a direct line of sight to the player. * The Lost Girl is moving in any direction (e.g. caused by falling or knockback). The Lost Girl is immune to the Confused debuff, but the transformed Nymph is not. The Nymph requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of her Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Old One's Skeleton
description: Dark Mage The '''Old One's Skeleton''' is a pre-Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by the Dark Mage during the Old One's Army event. The Old One's Skeleton requires 150 kills to be awarded completion of its corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Orca
description: The Orca is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ocean. It is a stronger version of the Shark, acting similarly but with higher stats. Throwing a Chum Bucket into Ocean water will multiply the spawn chance of Orcas by 2.78×. Unlike Chum Buckets' effect on Fishing Power, only one use is required to boost the spawn chance of Orcas to maximum possible value.

name: Paladin
description: The Paladin is a rare, resilient Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It is immune to knockback and attacks by rapidly throwing hammer projectiles which can pass through blocks and inflict extreme damage. The Paladin requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills. Paladins spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by brick walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Parrot
description: the enemy The Parrot is a Hardmode flying enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion. It flies towards the player in an attempt to deal contact damage. It will occasionally roost on any block if not pursuing the player, similarly to Ravens and Vultures.

name: Phantasm Dragon
description: 1.3.0.1 the enemy that appears during the Lunatic Cultist fight The Phantasm Dragon is a Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by the Lunatic Cultist. Its behavior is nearly identical to the Wyvern's. The Lunatic Cultist summons a Phantasm Dragon when the player attacks one of the Lunatic's duplicates or takes too long to hit the real one during its ritual attack. If the player does the above action again while a Phantasm Dragon is still alive, the Lunatic Cultist will summon an Ancient Vision instead.

name: Pigron
description: The Pigron is a Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome when it is overlapped with the Underground Corruption, Underground Crimson, or Underground Hallow. It has multiple color variants, depending on which overlapping biome it spawns in, but all share identical stats and behavior. Pigrons have a special ability to become transparent and nearly invisible, allowing them to fly through solid blocks. As a transparent Pigron starts to attack, it will become visible again. When it starts moving towards the player, it occasionally makes an audible growl. If it is in its solid, visible state and is blocked by solid blocks on its path to the player, it will become transparent again to pass through them.

name: Pinky
description: Pinky is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in place of certain types of other slimes (see Notes section for details). Despite its small size, Pinky has more health and defense than nearly all other pre-Hardmode slimes, though it has one of the lowest values of damage and knockback resistance in the game. It is also the only source of Pink Gel. Pinky requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Pirate Captain
description: the enemy The Pirate Captain is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event. Upon being within line of sight of the player, he attacks using an assault rifle-like gun that shoots at a speed comparable to the Minishark, then stops to fire a single cannonball from its underbarrel mounted cannon while stationary. The cannonball has a short range and detonates upon impact with blocks, much like those fired from the Flying Dutchman, and deals immense amounts of damage. A Pirate's Curse will be spawned when a Pirate Captain is killed. It will slowly drift towards the player through walls much like Wraiths, but it can freely fly through the air and does not need to hover on blocks. The Pirate Captain requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of his Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Pirate Corsair
description: The Pirate Corsair is a Hardmode enemy that spawns commonly during the Pirate Invasion. It moves towards the player by running and jumping, similar to the Pirate Deckhand, but has slightly higher stats.

name: Pirate Crossbower
description: The Pirate Crossbower is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event. She fires Flaming Arrows every few seconds, which deal high damage and have a chance of inflicting the On Fire! debuff for 7 / 14 / 17.5 seconds.

name: Pirate Deadeye
description: The Pirate Deadeye is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event. It appears similar to the Pirate Deckhand but comes armed with a blunderbuss that can fire bullets at the player, an eye patch, and slightly modified stats.

name: Pirate Deckhand
description: The Pirate Deckhand is a Hardmode enemy which appears during a Pirate Invasion. It moves towards the player by running and jumping, similar to the Pirate Corsair.

name: Pirate's Curse
description: 1.4.0.1 The '''Pirate's Curse''' is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Pirate Invasion event when a Pirate Captain is defeated. It can fly and move through blocks. It is completely unaffected by all traps, making it difficult to avoid in automated farms. If the player dies, it will momentarily hover and despawn.

name: Pixie
description: The Pixie is a Hardmode enemy that spawns frequently in The Hallow at the surface layer. Pixies hover a limited height aboveground, emitting a fair amount of flickering light, and can inflict the Slow or Silenced debuffs upon contact. They always drop Pixie Dust, a common Hardmode crafting material.

name: Poltergeist
description: The Poltergeist is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 4 / wave 5 of the Pumpkin Moon event. It behaves similarly to a Wraith, except it can fly freely through the air without needing solid ground to hover on. Defeating a Poltergeist during the Pumpkin Moon event will add 10 / 20 / 25 / 8 points to the final score. The Poltergeist requires 100 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Possessed Armor
description: The Possessed Armor is a Hardmode enemy which spawns on the surface at night, and underground at any time. It walks quickly and casts a motion blur similar to that of the Shadow armor. It can always open doors, regardless of whether or not there is a blood moon.

name: Predictor
description: Lunar Events The Predictor is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Nebula Pillar during the Lunar Events. It walks slowly until it is within the line-of-sight of the player, at which point it stops in place and releases four Nebula Piercer projectiles which rise up around it for , and then launches them towards the player in a tight spread.

name: Present Mimic
description: The Present Mimic is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Frost Moon event. It acts like normal Mimics do, but passes itself off as a present instead of a Chest. Present Mimics may spawn at any wave, instead of wave-appropriate enemies, if there are currently less than four Present Mimics around. Defeating a Present Mimic during the Frost Moon event will add 20 / 40 / 50 points to the final score.

name: Probe
description: Not to be confused with the Martian Probe, the post-Golem enemy that triggers the Martian Madness event. The Probe is a Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by The Destroyer. When one of its red-lit segments is damaged, there is a chance that a Probe is spawned from it. Probes can move through blocks and attack by firing Pink Lasers. Probes make fighting The Destroyer an easier and harder task at the same time – the Hearts they drop will keep the player alive, but they are a major source of damage during the boss fight.

name: Psycho
description: 1.3.0.1 The Psycho is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. He will initially spawn in a nearly invisible, stealthed state, waiting for the player to damage him or get closer than 10.625 tiles before he fully reveals himself, and starts attacking with a knife that deals heavy damage on contact.

name: Purple Slime
description: The Purple Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that commonly spawns in Forest biomes during the daytime. It is a larger and stronger variant of the Blue Slime. Purple Slimes will not usually target the player but will become aggressive when damaged, during the night, or if brought underground.

name: Ragged Caster
description: The Ragged Caster is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It attacks by firing volleys of three homing Lost Soul projectiles at the player which travel through blocks, decelerate as they approach the player, and inflict the Blackout debuff for 2–6 / 4–12 / 5–15 seconds on hit. Ragged Casters teleport to a different location on-screen after firing nine projectiles. Ragged Casters spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by slab walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Rainbow Slime
description: The Rainbow Slime is a rare Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns on Hallowed blocks ( in The Hallow on non-Hallowed blocks) while it is raining. It constantly changes color, as do the Rainbow Bricks it drops.

name: Raincoat Zombie
description: The Raincoat Zombie is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a Zombie variant that spawns during rain on the surface at night. It acts the same as normal zombies, slowly walking towards the player to deal contact damage, while attempting to navigate around obstacles and only being able to open doors during a Blood Moon. It is differentiated from other zombies in that it is dressed in traditional yellow raincoat attire, which it can also drop in the form of the Rain Hat and Rain Coat armor pieces. Raincoat Zombies can appear in three different size variations with slightly different stats. Unlike normal zombies, it does not have an Armed variation in Expert Mode.

name: Raven
description: the enemy The Raven is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that appears in Graveyard and can be found in the Forest at night during the Halloween seasonal event. It also has a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest tree during this time at night. Similarly to Vultures, Ravens will first be encountered roosting and will take flight when approached or attacked. It will hover over the player, waiting a few moments before swooping down to attack.

name: Ray Gunner
description: 1.3.0.1 The Ray Gunner is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It fires red laser projectiles, at a maximum fire rate of once every 0.67 seconds (40 ticks).

name: Reaper
description: The Reaper is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. On the , it will only spawn after all mechanical bosses have been defeated. Reapers behave in a similar manner to Wraiths, and have the same AI, but they have higher stats. They also move significantly faster than Wraiths, and with the higher spawn rate of the Solar Eclipse, they often attack from multiple directions at once. They are fairly vulnerable to knockback. Like many creatures that pass through blocks, they do not take damage from lava. Furthermore, weapons whose animations do not stop upon hitting blocks, like most melee weapons, will damage them despite not normally being able to attack through blocks.

name: Red Devil
description: Not to be confused with the pre-Hardmode enemy, the Demon. The Red Devil is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in The Underworld after any mechanical boss has been defeated. While flying toward the player in a similar manner to that of the Demon, it fires five purple trident projectiles that deal extremely large amounts of damage upon contact. It is considered a more difficult version of the Demon, having more health and dealing much more damage. Similar to the Demon, it drops a magic weapon resembling its means of attack, the Unholy Trident. While the contact damage of a Red Devil is comparably low, its trident attack is capable of dealing large amounts of damage even to players wearing endgame armor. The tridents are fired in the same burst-like pattern that Demons fire scythes in, although they are slower and move at a constant velocity.

name: Red Slime
description: The Red Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground layer, alongside Yellow Slimes. They are slightly stronger than Blue and Green Slimes.

name: Rock Golem
description: 1.4.0.1 the Hardmode Cavern enemy The Rock Golem is a powerful Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It throws rocks at players that are within its line of sight but out of its contact range. When being attacked, it continues to attack, making stun-lock options unusable. In For the Worthy and Zenith worlds, Rock Golems release a Boulder projectile on death.

name: Rune Wizard
description: The Rune Wizard is a rare Hardmode caster enemy that is found in the lower Cavern layer. He appears to be engulfed in flames, and attacks by firing magical, bright green Rune Blasts at the player that can pass through blocks, similar to other caster enemies such as Fire Imps and Dark Casters. However, unlike Burning Spheres, the Rune Wizard's projectiles cannot be destroyed in any way. He also deals extremely large amounts of contact damage and teleports to a new location after firing six projectiles. The Rune Wizard always drops the Rune Hat and Rune Robe upon death. The Rune Wizard requires 10 kills to be awarded completion of his Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Rusty Armored Bones
description: The Rusty Armored Bones is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Similar to Angry Bones, they come in multiple varieties and follow the Fighter AI. They have a chance to inflict the Bleeding debuff for 10 / 20 / 25 seconds and a chance to inflict the Slow debuff for 5 / 10 / 12.5 seconds. Only one of the debuffs can be inflicted at a time. Rusty Armored Bones spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by slab walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Salamander
description: 1.3.0.1 The Salamander is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Cavern layer, and has nine color variants that all share identical stats and behavior. When a player is within its line of sight, the Salamander stays rooted in place and fires green spit projectiles that have a chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 2–4 / 4–8 / 5–10 seconds. Salamanders are unique in that their ability to spawn is connected to two other enemies: the Crawdad and the Giant Shelly. Of these three enemies, a world will choose two types that it can spawn, leaving the third inaccessible. Salamanders will never spawn in a world that features both Crawdads and Giant Shellies together. This is taken into account by the Bestiary progression logic (the missing enemy will register as unlocked when the other two exclusive creatures are unlocked) and the acquisition (any two of the trio's banners can be used to craft the banner of the missing member of the trio).

name: Sand Elemental
description: 1.3.3 the rare, resilient enemy found in the Desert during Sandstorms The Sand Elemental is a rare Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert during Sandstorms. She attacks by summoning three Ancient Storms randomly around the general location of the player, which each lasts 5 seconds. The distance between them varies, and they remain stationary for their lifespan. The Sand Elemental cannot travel through blocks and flies in a non-linear pattern. She attempts to move toward the player and travels faster as her health is depleted. She has a guaranteed chance to drop a Forbidden Fragment, the main ingredient for the Forbidden armor, Spirit Flame, and Sandstorm in a Bottle. The Sand Elemental requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of her Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Sand Poacher
description: 1.3.0.1 The Sand Poacher is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Underground Desert biome. Following the Spider AI, it will follow and attempt to deal contact damage to the player while also being capable of climbing onto background walls. If the Sand Poacher is climbing on a wall and detects the player within its line of sight, its movement speed increases drastically, making escape more difficult for the player. Upon contact, the Sand Poacher also inflicts the Acid Venom debuff for 4 / 8 / 10 seconds.

name: Sand Slime
description: 1.3.0.1 The Sand Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground Desert. It can be recognized by its sandy color and texture. Sand Slimes can drop a Slime Staff at slightly higher odds than nearly all other slimes, excluding Pinky.

name: Scarecrow
description: The Scarecrow is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Pumpkin Moon event. There are ten varieties of Scarecrow, five of which lack legs and can only move by jumping, while the other five follow the normal Fighter AI. Scarecrows have a chance to inflict the Weak debuff for 1 minute / 2 minutes / 2 minutes and 30 seconds. Defeating a Scarecrow during the Pumpkin Moon event will add 1 / 2 / 2.5 points to the final score. All Scarecrow varieties require 150 kills to be awarded completion of their Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Scutlix
description: Martian Madness The Scutlix is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that spawns during the Martian Madness event. It consists of the Scutlix creature, ridden by a Scutlix Gunner enemy, both of which have individual health meters and can be killed independently. When one is killed, the other will continue to attack.

name: Selenian
description: 1.3.0.1 The Selenian is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. It is a ground-based enemy that wields two flaming swords and possesses a spinning attack that causes it to quickly lunge forward while reflecting the player's projectiles. It takes triple the damage from other player-inflicted sources while spinning. Selenians can reflect bullets, arrows, and darts, but not rockets, and the projectiles of numerous other weapons. For the complete list, see the list of reflected projectiles.

name: Servant of Cthulhu
description: The Servant of Cthulhu is a pre-Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by the Eye of Cthulhu during its first stage.

name: Shadowflame Apparition
description: Goblin Warlock The Shadowflame Apparition is a Hardmode enemy summoned by the Goblin Warlock during the Goblin Army event. Summoned in swarms as projectiles, they pass through blocks while attempting to ram into the player. They are immune to knockback, and both they and their caster move very quickly, allowing them to easily overwhelm the player.

name: Sharkron
description: The Sharkron is a Hardmode boss servant fired by Duke Fishron's Sharknado and Cthulhunado attacks. They will first spawn from within the Sharknado or Cthulhunado, staying inside it for some time before being launched directly at the player. They travel in an arc, descending at a slower speed after reaching maximum height. They are killed instantly upon impact with blocks. Despite being shark-related, Sharkrons do not move faster in water.

name: Shimmer Slime
description: 1.4.4 The Shimmer Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that cannot be found naturally, and is instead created when most varieties of slimes come into contact with Shimmer or upon being sprayed by the Shimmer Gun (with exceptions below). Shimmer Slimes have the ability to reflect projectiles, similarly to Shimmer itself. For the complete list, see the list of reflected projectiles.

name: Skeleton
description: Not to be confused with the boss, Skeletron. The Skeleton is a pre-Hardmode enemy that frequently spawns in the Cavern layer as one of many variants. Regular Skeletons can be spawned by the Skeleton Statue. Like many other enemies that follow the Fighter AI, Skeletons can open doors and Tall Gate, albeit only during Blood Moons or rarely in Graveyards. In Expert Mode, certain Skeletons are able to throw bones when they are close to the player. Regular bone-throwing Skeletons can be spawned by the Bone Skeleton Statue in any difficulty.

name: Skeleton Archer
description: The Skeleton Archer is a Hardmode enemy that sometimes spawns in the Cavern layer. They move fairly slow compared to other cave enemies. When the player is in their line of sight, they will stop moving and shoot Flaming Arrows at the player, which have a chance of inflicting the On Fire! debuff.

name: Skeleton Commando
description: The Skeleton Commando is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It slowly approaches the player, and upon getting within their line of sight, stops in place before firing Rockets that explode upon contact with solid blocks. Skeleton Commandos spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by brick walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Skeleton Sniper
description: The Skeleton Sniper is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. It attacks from long range, slowly approaching the player. As soon as it has a clear line of sight, it pauses briefly before firing a single shot. This shot can be fired from offscreen, travels at an extremely high velocity, and deals enough damage to kill a player with 500 health in three / two / one hit(s). Skeleton Snipers spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by slab walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Slimeling
description: The Slimeling is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in groups of two to three upon the death of a Corrupt Slime. Like its parent, it has a chance of inflicting the Darkness debuff for 15 / 30 / 37.5 seconds.

name: Slimer
description: The Slimer is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in The Corruption and Underground Corruption. It spawns as a winged slime, attacking the player using the Bat AI pattern. Once "killed" for the first time, the slime body drops to the ground, continuing to fight using the Slime AI pattern.

name: Snatcher
description: The Snatcher is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the surface Jungle, and is nearly identical in appearance and behavior to the Underground Jungle's Man Eater. Snatchers spawn anchored to blocks, with an extendable stem topped by a pincher. The stem itself is a passive component and can be walked through safely without incurring damage; only the pincher inflicts or takes damage.

name: Snow Balla
description: The Snow Balla is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Frost Legion event. It moves by hopping towards the player and throws snowballs at them which form Snow Blocks on impact with other blocks, similar to the attack of an Antlion. The Snow Blocks can also spawn in the air if the Snow Balla throws it into the sky.

name: Snow Flinx
description: The Snow Flinx is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Ice biome (another name for the Cavern layer Snow biome). It is susceptible to knockback, and when hit, will tumble over and fly backwards.

name: Snowman Gangsta
description: The Snowman Gangsta is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Frost Legion event. It moves by hopping toward the player while occasionally firing bullets at them at a slow rate, and can only shoot left or right.

name: Spike Ball
description: The Spike Ball is an invincible NPC found in the Dungeon which resembles a mace that swings around in a circle from a central pivot point (usually attached to a block), and deals damage to the player on contact. Separate Spike Balls can have differing chain lengths. Spike Balls spawn and despawn off-screen like any other enemy. Spike Balls spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by slab walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Spiked Ice Slime
description: The Spiked Ice Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Ice biome. The Spiked Ice Slime fires Ice Spikes at the player, and the Ice Spikes and the slime itself always inflict the Chilled debuff, and also have a smaller chance to inflict the Frozen debuff. In Classic Mode, the Spiked Ice Slime only fires one Ice Spike at a time, approximately every 1.5 seconds. In Expert Mode, however, it shoots 6–8 Ice Spikes around itself in a short range.

name: Spiked Jungle Slime
description: The Spiked Jungle Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground Jungle. It fires Jungle Spikes at the player which have a chance to inflict the Poisoned debuff. In Expert Mode, it can also fire five Jungle Spikes at once around itself in a short range.

name: Spiked Slime
description: 1.3.0.1 The Spiked Slime is a pre-Hardmode slime and boss servant that is summoned by King Slime in Expert Mode alongside Blue Slimes, becoming more common as the boss loses health. Like the Spiked Ice Slime and Spiked Jungle Slime, it has the ability to shoot spike projectiles at the player.

name: Splinterling
description: The Splinterling is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 2 of the Pumpkin Moon event. It is one of the only sources of Spooky Wood, the other being the Mourning Wood. Defeating a Splinterling during the Pumpkin Moon event will add 2 / 4 / 5 points to the final score. The Splinterling requires 150 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Spore Bat
description: 1.4.0.1 The Spore Bat is a pre-Hardmode bat enemy that spawns in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes. It has the same stats as a Cave Bat. However, Spore Bats have a chance to drop a Shroomerang. In Expert Mode, it can inflict the Feral Bite debuff for 30–90 seconds.

name: Spore Skeleton
description: 1.4.0.1 The Spore Skeleton is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in Underground Glowing Mushroom biomes, specficially within the Cavern layer. Its behavior, drops, and statistics are all equivalent to normal Skeletons.

name: Spore Zombie
description: The Spore Zombie is a zombie variant that only appears on Mushroom Grass above the Surface at any point in the game. It acts the same as normal zombies, slowly walking towards the player to deal contact damage, while attempting to navigate around obstacles. However, it is differentiable by normal zombies due to its mushroom-covered appearance, spawning at any time of day, and generally more powerful stats. Unlike normal zombies, it is always able to open doors regardless of whether or not it is a Blood Moon. Spore Zombies can appear in two different variations with slightly different stats. Unlike normal zombies, it does not have an armed variation in Expert Mode.

name: Sroller
description: 1.3.0.1 The Sroller is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Solar Pillar during the Lunar Events. It can curl into a ball, start spinning and hurls itself at the player, gaining increased defense and dealing high contact damage, similarly to a Giant Tortoise or Ice Tortoise. The Sroller can also create explosions on impact with blocks, dealing even higher area of effect damage.

name: Star Cell
description: 1.3.0.1 the enemy The Star Cell is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It floats slowly towards the player but can move at a faster rate if the player begins moving away from it. Upon death, it splits into multiple Mini Star Cells. If these Mini Star Cells are not dealt with, they will grow into a full-sized Star Cell, that can also split into more Mini Star Cells. Mini Star Cells do not contribute to the kill count required to break the Stardust Pillar's shield, though after growing back, they do.

name: Stargazer
description: 1.3.0.1 The Stargazer is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It walks slowly until it is within the line-of-sight of the player, at which point it stops in place, and fires a large Stardust Laser from its chest towards the player that lingers for a short while. The laser momentarily appears as a harmless thin beam, before quickly widening and damaging the player.

name: Statue (enemy)
description: 1.4.5.0 The Statue is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron enemy that spawns in Graveyard biomes. It is more likely to spawn around players with negative luck. It will spawn and act as a random Statue until approached, where it will shriek and start to pursue the player by aggressively stomping towards them, even going through blocks to reach them if needed. It will drop the statue it appears as on death. If its current targeting player is dead, the Statue will laugh. The Statue requires 10 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry, as opposed to the usual 50 kills. Unlike most enemies, it does not have a corresponding banner.

name: Storm Diver
description: 1.3.0.1 The Storm Diver is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. Storm Divers wield a type of ranged weapon that is able to fire tight spreads of projectiles, similar to the Tactical Shotgun. Storm Divers are also able to glide and hover with what appear to be jetpacks. They appear to have mud-colored skin, a green glass helmet, cyan-colored claws, cyan lights, and an alien-like shotgun.

name: Swamp Thing
description: The Swamp Thing is a Hardmode enemy that commonly spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. He moves very fast and occasionally stops in place.

name: Tactical Skeleton
description: The Tactical Skeleton is a rare Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns in the Dungeon after Plantera is defeated. Once the player is within its line of sight, the Tactical Skeleton remains stationary before firing spreads of four bullets at them that deal immense damage. Tactical Skeletons spawn most often in areas of the Dungeon backed by tiled walls. They can also spawn in other areas, but with a significantly reduced chance.

name: Tesla Turret
description: 1.3.0.1 The Tesla Turret is a Hardmode enemy found only during the Martian Madness event. It is built by Martian Engineers and is completely immobile. Every three seconds, it will fire an Electric Bolt at the player, which has a chance to inflict the Electrified debuff for 5 seconds. The Tesla Turret will continue to stay in place until it is destroyed by the player.

name: The Bride
description: 1.3.0.1 The Bride is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns rarely during a Blood Moon or very rarely at any time in a Graveyard biome. She acts the same as regular Zombies. The Groom is her themed counterpart. The Bride requires 10 kills to be awarded completion of her Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: The Groom
description: The Groom is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns rarely during a Blood Moon or very rarely at any time in a Graveyard biome. He acts the same as regular Zombies. The Bride is his themed counterpart. The Groom requires 10 kills to be awarded completion of his Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: The Possessed
drops: This Is Getting Out Of Hand (1.67%)
description: 1.3.0.1 The Possessed is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Despite not resembling one, she acts similarly to spider-type enemies, climbing on background walls when able to and walking on the ground at all other times. While climbing on walls, The Possessed has increased movement speed and gains complete immunity to knockback.

name: Tim
description: Tim is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy found in the lower Cavern layer. With an appearance similar to Dark Casters, he can be distinguished by his Wizard Hat, which is guaranteed to drop when he is defeated. Like other casters, Tim will fire three destructible Chaos Balls that pass through solid blocks before teleporting to another visible location on the screen. On the , equipping one of the Gem Robe variants in the armor slot without a Wizard Hat will boost Tim's spawn rate by 5 times. Tim requires 10 kills to be awarded completion of his Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Tomb Crawler
description: 1.3.0.1 The Tomb Crawler is a pre-Hardmode worm enemy found in the Underground Desert. Following the same AI pattern as Giant Worms, it moves through solid blocks to attack the player by charging. The sound of its burrowing grows louder and faster as it draws near. Like many other worm-type enemies, its head segment deals more damage on contact, but is also the part of its body most vulnerable to damage. It is the pre-Hardmode counterpart of the Dune Splicer.

name: Tortured Soul
description: 1.3.0.1 The Tortured Soul is an uncommon Hardmode enemy found in The Underworld. If the player throws Purification Powder on him, he will transform into the Tax Collector NPC. Afterwards, the Tortured Soul will no longer spawn. Using Clentaminator does not have any effect on him. If the Tax Collector is killed, he will respawn naturally without the need to purify another Tortured Soul. Only one Tortured Soul can be alive at a time.

name: Toxic Sludge
description: The Toxic Sludge is a Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground layer in place of ordinary slimes. It deals significantly increased damage and has a chance of inflicting the Poisoned debuff for 10 / 20 / 25 seconds, which it is also immune to.

name: True Eye of Cthulhu
description: 1.3.0.1 Not to be confused with the Eye of Cthulhu boss, The Eye of Cthulhu yoyo, or the Suspicious Looking Tentacle light pet. The True Eye of Cthulhu is an invincible Hardmode boss servant that spawns when an eye of the Moon Lord is defeated. Since the Moon Lord has three eyes to defeat before his core is revealed, there will eventually be three True Eyes of Cthulhu pursuing the player until the end of the battle.

name: Twinkle Popper
description: 1.3.0.1 The Twinkle Popper is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It walks slowly until it is within the line-of-sight of the player, at which point it stops in place and attacks the player by vomiting up smaller enemies called Twinkles, which run around and can explode into an upwards spray of 3 damaging sparkles when close to the player or after have passed. Killing the Twinkles prevents them from exploding into sparkles.

name: Umbrella Slime
description: The Umbrella Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns during rainy days on the surface, holding an umbrella. It is larger than and statistically superior to Blue and Green Slimes.

name: Undead Miner
description: The Undead Miner is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer and follows the Fighter AI. Undead Miners wear a Mining Helmet, which provides a small amount of light around them. This light makes them much easier to find and can sometimes reveal sealed caves, much like blooming Blinkroot. Undead Miners can open doors, but they can only do so during Blood Moons or in Graveyards. Killing them is the only way to obtain the Bone Pickaxe, Mining Shirt, and the Mining Pants. The Mining Helmet can be obtained from Undead Miners, but can also be bought from the Merchant for .

name: Undead Viking
description: The Undead Viking is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome. It behaves similarly to the Skeleton, but spawns more frequently and jumps higher.

name: Unicorn
description: The Unicorn is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Hallow. It is a very fast enemy that has a rather large amount of health and can jump approximately 7 tiles high and 20 tiles wide. The Unicorn leaps around and charges, attempting to trample the player. Its unpredictable and speedy behavior, combined with a high damage output, can make fighting it difficult. It always drops one Unicorn Horn, a valued item. It also rarely drops the Blessed Apple, a strong Mount-summoning item for early Hardmode.

name: Vampire
description: The Vampire is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. It will transform into a bat if the player is far enough away from it, and attempts to fly near the player at high speed before turning back into a humanoid. It inflicts the Bleeding debuff upon contact with the player for 5–7 / 10–14 / 12.5–17.5 seconds.

name: Vicious Bunny
description: 1.3.0.1 The Vicious Bunny is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Bunny that has been corrupted, either by the player using Vicious Powder on it or when a Bunny spawns during a Blood Moon in a Crimson world.

name: Vicious Penguin
description: 1.3.0.1 The Vicious Penguin is a pre-Hardmode enemy that results from a Penguin that has been corrupted, either by the player using Vicious Powder on it or when a Penguin spawns during a Blood Moon in a Crimson world.

name: Voodoo Demon
description: The Voodoo Demon is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in The Underworld. It is identical to the Demon in behavior, but differs slightly in appearance: a small Guide Voodoo Doll hangs upside-down from one of its talons, and it lacks the blue bracelets and anklets that are worn by regular Demons. Voodoo Demons will always drop a Guide Voodoo Doll when killed. Due to the terrain of the Underworld, defeating a Voodoo Demon may result in an unwanted summoning of the Wall of Flesh if the doll falls into one of the many large bodies of lava throughout the Underworld.

name: Vortexian
description: 1.3.0.1 The Vortexian is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. It walks towards the player, trying to deal contact damage. Upon death, a portal is summoned that shoots a lightning bolt aimed at the player, indicated by a glowing line, similar to one of the attacks of the Lunatic Cultist and the lightning portal of the Vortex Pillar. They are powerful in packs, and can potentially start an overwhelming lightning chain reaction if not dealt with properly.

name: Vulture
description: The Vulture is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy that commonly spawns in Deserts during the day; however, they can also spawn roosting on Sand Blocks in any biome. When the player comes close or attacks a Vulture, it will begin to fly at the player. Vultures will hover above the player for a second before swooping down to attack. They will continue to pursue the player until they die.

name: Wall Creeper
description: The Wall Creeper is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be found in and around Spider Nests in the Cavern layer, mostly during pre-Hardmode. Wall Creepers are spider-like enemies capable of climbing background walls as well as through platforms, but revert to acting like fighter enemies when there are no background walls for them to climb on.

name: Wandering Eye
description: The Wandering Eye is a Hardmode flying enemy that spawns on the surface at night. It behaves like a larger Demon Eye, as it pursues the player, bounces off blocks, and is highly susceptible to knockback. However, when its health is reduced to below 50% ( / / ), the Wandering Eye's pupil will peel off and reveal a mouth with a row of sharp teeth, similar to the Eye of Cthulhu's second phase, and gains increased movement speed, but its behavior otherwise remains unchanged. Similarly to Demon Eyes, Wandering Eyes will flee when the sun rises before despawning when off-screen.

name: Wandering Eye Fish
description: 1.4.0.1 The Wandering Eye Fish is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be spawned by fishing in water during a Blood Moon. When the bobber dips and the player attempts to reel in a fish, a Wandering Eye Fish or another enemy has a chance to spawn within a few tiles of the bobber in place of a fish. The Wandering Eye Fish requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Water Bolt Mimic
description: 1.4.5.0 The Water Bolt Mimic is a rare pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in front of placed Books in the Dungeon. It disguises itself as a placed Water Bolt until it takes damage, at which point it begins attacking the player. While attacking, it floats around the player and goes through blocks in a similar manner to Cursed Skulls. Additionally, it randomly alternates between firing destructible Water Spheres that go through blocks, dashing away from the player to keep distance, and dashing towards the player at high speed. The Water Bolt Mimic has a chance to drop the Water Bolt upon death.

name: Werewolf
description: the Werewolf enemy The Werewolf is a Hardmode enemy that commonly spawns at night only while a full moon is active. Werewolves can open doors and have a chance to inflict the Bleeding debuff for 45 / 90 / 112.5 seconds. At close range, Werewolves attack the player by leaping or lunging, closing distances quickly to catch unwary players off-guard. The Werewolf can drop the Moon Charm, which allows the player to transform into a Werewolf at night.

name: White Cultist Archer
description: 1.3.0.1 .]] The White Cultist Archer is a Cultist variant that exists in Terraria's game files, but never actually spawns. It looks and behaves identically to the Blue Cultist Archer that appears in-game.

name: Windy Balloon
description: 1.4.0.1 The Windy Balloon is a unique pre-Hardmode flying enemy that only spawns during the Windy Day event in daytime. It carries a slime which is bound to the string underneath. The balloon will pop if the player hits it or gets too close, or if it reaches the ground or comes in contact with a liquid, causing the slime to fall to the ground. The Windy Balloon itself does not deal damage, whereas the slime attached to it does, both while flying and after the balloon is popped. The Windy Balloon does not drop any items when popped. Its loot can only be obtained by defeating the slime, which may drop one of the Windy Balloon's unique items along with its regular loot. There are 7 differently colored variants of the Windy Balloon, all of which behave identically.

name: Wither Beast
description: Old One's Army The Wither Beast is a Hardmode enemy that spawns during the Old One's Army event. It spawns during Tier 2 during waves 6–7, and Tier 3 during waves 5–7. When a Wither Beast is within 25 tiles of a player, it will briefly dig its way into the ground for approximately three seconds before burying itself, becoming stationary and emitting a 25-tile radius aura of purple crystals, visually similar to the Dryad's Blessing. This aura inflicts the Withered Armor debuff, which halves the player's defense for as long as the player is within the aura's radius, and disappears immediately when the player leaves the zone. When stationary, the Wither Beast will also regenerate its health when damaged, healing at a rate of 5% maximum health per second ( / / health per second in Tier 2, or / / health per second in Tier 3). It is one of only two enemies from the Old One's Army that requires the usual 50 kills to obtain its corresponding banner, the other being the Etherian Lightning Bug.

name: Wolf
description: The Wolf is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Snow biome at night. It has the same AI as the Unicorn, and attacks by leaping and charging into the player. Like Unicorns, Wolves move at very fast speeds and can jump fairly high, making them one of the hardest enemies to evade. Due to its relatively high defense and health, it is not recommended for early Hardmode players to fight these animals. If the player does happen to come across them, it is difficult to outrun them, even with sprinting accessories.

name: World Feeder
description: The World Feeder is a Hardmode worm-like enemy which spawns in The Corruption, and can be considered the Hardmode counterpart of the Devourer. Loot is dropped from its head segment, so it can get stuck and buried deep in blocks if one of the main body parts is killed first.

name: Wraith
description: The Wraith is a Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface at night, can travel through blocks, and has a chance to inflict the Slow debuff upon contact with the player for 15 / 30 / 37.5 seconds. They have ghostly, pitch-black bodies which render them almost completely invisible in dark areas, but have two glowing red eyes that remain visible even in complete darkness. Although Wraiths appear to fly freely, they can only hover slightly above the ground. They need foreground blocks to "swim" through in order to fly any higher.

name: Wyvern
description: The Wyvern is a large Hardmode enemy that spawns in Space. It resembles a long, white and follows the Worm AI. It will follow descending players down to ground level and can fly through blocks, but regular Wyverns tend not to fly below ground. Wyverns will only spawn when the player is above a certain altitude (see Space altitudes) and is outside of the Dungeon biome. Furthermore, Wyverns have additional spawn conditions.

name: Yellow Slime
description: Not to be confused with the Mystic Slime, a yellow Town Slime. The Yellow Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in the Underground layer, alongside Red Slimes. They are slightly larger and stronger than Purple Slimes.

name: Yeti
description: The Yeti is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that begins to spawn during wave 12 of the Frost Moon event. It behaves similarly to Krampus and the Nutcracker, although it is much stronger and is immune to knockback. Defeating a Yeti during the Frost Moon event will add 18 / 36 / 45 points to the current score.

name: Zombie
description: The Zombie is a common pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on the surface at night, and is a primary reason newer players will want to build a shelter before night arrives. Along with Demon Eyes, they are generally among the first nighttime enemies a player will encounter, as they appear in areas a player first spawns. Zombies follow the Fighter AI and walk towards the player, dealing damage on contact. They can jump and navigate platforms. Zombies will seem to hit closed doors and Tall Gate in their path repeatedly, though most of them cannot open them unless it is a Blood Moon (any regular and Blood Zombie that spawn during which are all able to open doors/Tall Gates); Spore Zombie and Maggot Zombie can open doors and Tall Gates at any time. See Fighter AI for more details. In Expert Mode, Armed Zombies that carry disembodied arms will spawn. When they are close to the player, they will stop to perform a special "claw attack" which extends their attack range and deals more damage to the player. These arm-wielding zombies are unable to open or interact with doors at any time. The Armed Zombie Statue can spawn regular Armed Zombies in any difficulty.

name: Zombie Elf
description: The Zombie Elf is a Hardmode, post-Plantera enemy that spawns during the Frost Moon event. They are the most basic fighter-type enemy that spawns during the event, and despite being relatively easy to hold off, they still deal heavy contact damage. Defeating a Zombie Elf during the Frost Moon event will add 1 / 2 / 2.5 points to the final score. All Zombie Elf varieties require 100 kills to be awarded completion of their Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.

name: Zombie Merman
description: 1.4.0.1 The Zombie Merman is a pre-Hardmode enemy that can be spawned by fishing in water during a Blood Moon. When the bobber dips and the player attempts to reel in a fish, a Zombie Merman or another enemy has a chance to spawn within a few tiles of the bobber in place of a fish. While hindered by a somewhat slow initial walking speed, the Zombie Merman gains exceptional mobility and maneuverability when inside liquids, and can leap out of them with great speed if needed. The Zombie Merman also becomes faster as its health is further depleted. The Zombie Merman requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.
